Title: Need to introduce a new train from Guna to Indore. 

श्री रोड़मल नागर (राजगढ़) : महोदय, आपने मुझे अपने क्षेत्र के महत्वपूर्ण वि­ाय को उठाने का अवसर दिया, इसके लिए मैं आपको धन्यवाद देता हूं।

मेरे संसदीय क्षेत्र राजगढ़ में मध्य प्रदेश, जबलपुर मंडल के अंतर्गत गुना-मक्सी रेलखंड आता है। जिस पर गुना से इंदौर के मध्य कोई भी रेल नहीं चलती है। इसके लिए रेलवे प्रशासन को गुना से इंदौर के मध्य इंटरसिटी एक्सप्रेस रेल चलाने की सख्त आवश्यकता है। 

मध्य प्रदेश के प्रमुख व्यापारिक नगर इंदौर होने से गुना, ब्यावरा, पचौर, राजगढ़, सारंगपुर इत्यादि अधिकांश स्थानों से इंदौर के लिए ही व्यापारिक सारे काम होते हैं। गंभीर बीमारियों के लिए भी तत्काल उच्च स्तरीय चिकित्सा सुविधा के इंदौर का आवागमन काफी लंबा और असुविधापूर्ण बना हुआ है। इस क्षेत्र में एकमात्र रेल खंड गुना-मक्सी है। इस पर प्रतिदिन लगभग 5 से 7 हजार लोग यात्रा करते हैं। रेल सुविधा नहीं होने की वजह से क्षेत्र के विकास में कई प्रकार की बाधायें आती हैं। 

श्रीमान् से आपके माध्यम से निवेदन है कि गुना-मक्सी रेल खंड पर एक इंटरसिटी गुना से इंदौर के लिए चलाई जाए तो क्षेत्र की जनता को ज्यादा से ज्यादा लाभ होगा, धन्यवाद।

Title: Need to construct a rake point at Bairganiya station in Sheohar Parliamentary Constitutency in Bihar. 

श्रीमती रमा देवी (शिवहर): महोदय, पूर्व मध्य रेलवे जोन के अन्तर्गत बैरगनिया रेलवे स्टेशन मेरे संसदीय क्षेत्र शिवहर के समस्तीपुर रेल मंडल के सीतामढ़ी-रक्सौल रेल खंड पर है। बैरगनिया प्रखंड भारत-नेपाल सीमा पर अवस्थित है। बार्डर के दूसरी तरफ नेपाल का गौर नामक पुराना और बड़ा शहर अवस्थित है। बैरगनिया में जहाँ एक ओर भारत सरकार के कस्टम विभाग का सीमा शुल्क कार्यालय है, वहीं दूसरी ओर नेपाल सरकार का बड़ा भंसार कार्यालय है। 

विदित हो कि व्यापारिक दृ­िटकोण से सीमावर्ती क्षेत्र होने के कारण बैरगनिया और गौर दोनों शहर अपने-अपने देश के लिए काफी महत्वपूर्ण हैं। भारत-नेपाल दोनों देशों को जोड़ने के लिए पहले से ही बेहतर सड़क मार्ग निर्मित है, जिससे कि न सिर्फ बैरगनिया या गौर के आम लोगों बल्कि दोनों देशों के दूर-दराज के व्यापारियों का बैरगनिया शहर आना-जाना होता है। इनका मुख्य रेलवे स्टेशन बैरगनिया ही है। विदित हो कि 15वीं लोक सभा में मेरे प्रयास से तत्कालीन रेल मंत्री जी के द्वारा बैरगनिया रेलवे स्टेशन को आदर्श स्टेशन का दर्जा प्राप्त है। बैरगनिया रेलवे स्टेशन पर रेल विभाग की 50 एकड़ से भी अधिक जमीन खाली पड़ी हुई है। बैरगनिया के व्यापारियों की शुरू से यह माँग रही है कि यदि उक्त खाली जमीन पर रेलवे के रैक प्वाइंट का निर्माण हो जाता है तो बैरगनिया के व्यापारियों को काफी लाभ मिलेगा। साथ ही कस्टम ऑफिस होने के कारण नेपाल के व्यापारी भी इस रैक प्वाइंट का इस्तेमाल करेंगे, जिससे भारत सरकार को भी राजस्व का लाभ मिलेगा। 

अतः सदन के माध्यम से सरकार से अनुरोध है कि जनहित में पूर्व-मध्य रेलवे जोन के अंतर्गत बैरगनिया स्टेशन पर रैक प्वाइंट का निर्माण कराया जाए, जिससे बैरगनिया के साथ-साथ इसके आसपास के इलाके के व्यापारियों की कठिनाई दूर हो और राजस्व की भी वृद्धि हो। आपका बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद।

श्री अश्विनी कुमार चौबे (बक्सर) : महोदय, बिहार में हमारे संसदीय क्षेत्र नावा नगर थाना के अंतर्गत विगत दिनों एक महादलित गरीब परिवार, शिव जी, पासी के चौदह व­ाावय गुंगी बच्ची के साथ छठ प्रसाद संदेश के रूप में बांटने के क्रम में, इसराफिल उर्फ राजू ने उसे अपने घर में जबर्दस्ती ले जाकर, उसके साथ दु­कर्म किया। दु­कर्म के बाद वह लगातार चौकी के नीचे बेहोश पड़ी रही, उसके मुंह से फेन निकल रहा था। मोहल्ले वाले ने खोज कर उस पीड़िता को निकाला और आम जनता ने मिल कर राजू को थाने में सुपुर्द किया। आज 12 दिन हो गये हैं, लेकिन आज तक उस बच्ची का सघन इलाज प्रशासन और सरकार ने नहीं किया है। यह घोर आश्चर्य की बात है। मैं स्वयं जांच टीम के साथ गया था। आज उस घटना का बारहवां दिन है, वहां धरना-प्रदर्शन, स्वतः बाजार बंद हो रहे हैं, वहां लगातार आंदोलन चल रहे हैं, लेकिन प्रशासन और सरकार द्वारा इस घटना को झूठलाने का प्रयास किया जा रहा है। मैंने कल इस आशय का महामहिम राज्यपाल जी को भी ज्ञापन सौंपा है। 

मैं आपके माध्यम से सरकार से आग्रह करता हूं कि इस घटना का विशे­ा मेडिकल टीम द्वारा जांच करायी जाये तथा पीड़िता की सघन चिकित्सा-व्यवस्था की जाये जिससे उसकी जान बच सके। साथ ही, पीड़िता को 25 लाख रुपये मुआवजा के तौर पर भुगतान करने एवं उसे इंदिरा आवास के तहत भवन निर्माण कराया जाये। इस घटना को दबाने वाले पदाधिकारियों को चिन्हित कर दंडित करने तथा दु­कर्म करने वाले अपराधी को कठोर सजा दी जाये। इसके साथ ही पीड़िता का साथ देने वाले लोगों के ऊपर से असत्य मुकदमा वापस लिया जाये।

Title: Regarding release of Indian fishermen arrested by Sri Lankan Navy. 

DR. J. JAYAVARDHAN (CHENNAI SOUTH): Hon. Deputy Speaker, Sir, I would like to bring to the notice of the august House an important issue regarding the string of unfortunate instances of apprehension and arrest of Tamil Nadu fishermen by the Sri Lankan Navy while peacefully pursuing their traditional livelihood in the Palk Bay.

In the latest incident, eight fishermen who set out for fishing in two mechanised fishing boats from Rameswaram fishing base in Ramanathapuram district and Jegathapattinam fishing village in Pudukottai district have been apprehended by the Sri Lankan Navy in the early hours of 29.11.2015 and taken to Kankesanthurai in Sri Lanka.

Our hon. Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, Puratchi Thalaivi Amma has written a letter to the hon. Prime Minister in this regard. Hence, the Ministry of External Affairs should immediately take up the matter with the Sri Lankan authorities in a concrete and decisive manner so as to secure the immediate release of 37 fishermen and 55 fishing boats including the eight fishermen and two fishing boats apprehended on 29.11.2015 and also expedite the return of four Indian fishermen and their motorised craft which drifted to the Sri Lankan shores on 8.11.2015 due to mechanical failure and remain still stranded there.

Title: Regarding ISO certification of all CMOs and Central and State government departments. 

SHRI THOTA NARASIMHAM (KAKINADA): Sir, I want to make a very important and pertinent recommendation to the Government.

The Gujarat CMO (Chief Minister's Office) acquired ISO- 9001:2000 certification in the year January, 2009 during the tenure of Shri Narendra Modi as the Chief Minister of Gujarat. The Gujarat CMO was the first in the country to acquire the ISO 9001: 2000 certification. This certification is awarded for "administration and overall governance". The notable aspect here is that the certificate was not attained as a piece of paper to exhibit, but the processes in the CMO had actually undergone a distinct change. CMO was audited by a third party for performance standards.

Information Technology (IT) is used for all the internal processes. Majority of the CMO is online; 80 per cent of CMO is paperless. Any communication with the CM is online. Anyone wants to seek his appointment, any application etc, is all done online. I heard that when Modi ji was the CM, he used to receive 500 mails every day, but after screening and filtering, synopsis of around 150-200 mails were sent to him every day. He used to comment and revert back on every mail daily. All the mails were forwarded to the respective Departments and followed up on a monthly basis. Every mail he received was archived and docketed properly. This is the beauty of the ISO certification. It develops transparency, accountability and ensures swift action.

I take this opportunity to request the Prime Minister Modi ji to prepare an action plan in the lines of Gujarat CMO and ensure to get ISO certification to all the CMOs of the country in the first phase and all Central Government Departments in the second phase and all the State Government Departments in the third phase. Thank you.

HON. DEPUTY SPEAKER: Shri Arjun Ram Meghwal is permitted to associate with the issue raised by Shri Thota Narasimham.

Title: Need to extend financial assistance by the central government to state governments for implementing welfare measures in tribal settlements. 

SHRI M. UDHAYAKUMAR (DINDIGUL): Hon. Deputy Speaker, Sir, Vanakkam.

There are 7,94,697 tribal people in the entire Tamil Nadu State which comprises 1.10 per cent of total tribe in the country and 0.76 per cent of the population of Tamil Nadu.

Kodaikanal is sometimes referred to as the “princess of hill stations”. There are 30 tribal villages having 16 panchayats called Adukkm, Kilakuchettipatti, Vaadagounchi, Thandikudi, Toolathur, Kookal and Kamanur in Dindigul district, Tamil Nadu. The total Number of tribal population in Dindigul district is 6,484. The total number of tribal population in Kodaikanal Hill Station in 16 Panchayats, and one municipality is 2,014. Forests have always been an open resource for livelihood and cultural interaction for the tribal inhabitants. 

The State Government of Tamil Nadu headed by hon. Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, Dr. Puratchi Thalaivi Amma, has given emphasis upon improving the quality of life of the socially disadvantaged groups viz., Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. The major welfare activities are educational development, economic development, housing and other schemes, Special Component Plan programmes and Tribal Sub-Plan programmes. The government at the Centre has suppressed the "Report of The High Level Committee on Socio-Economic, Health and Educational Status of Tribal Communities of India".

I urge upon the Minister for Tribal Affairs to accept the report and implement the slew of welfare measures to uplift the socio-economic conditions of the Tribal people in the Kodaikanal hills and the nation in general. I request the government to provide infrastructural support for the development of Tribal settlements to provide education there by improving the standard of living of Tribals in forest areas; and to construct the road and facilities for the Tribal community living areas. The Central Government should extend all financial assistance to the concerned State Government for implementing welfare measures in tribal settlements so as to fight the left wing extremism.

Title: Need to implement, the final verdict of Cauvery River Water Tribunal and setting up of Cauvery Management Board and Cauvery Water Regulatory Authority. 

SHRI K. PARASURAMAN (THANJAVUR): Hon. Deputy Speaker, Vanakkam. Cauvery river water issue is one among the contentious river water issues concerning Tamil Nadu. The agreements entered between erstwhile Madras presidency and the Princely State of Mysore during the years 1892 and 1924 clearly express the rights of Tamil Nadu over river Cauvery. During July 1986, the Tamil Nadu government urged upon the Union government to set up Cauvery river water Tribunal as regards sharing of Cauvery water. After the Orders of Hon. Supreme Court in May 1990, as per the Inter-State River Water Sharing Act of 1956, the Union Government had setup Cauvery River Water Tribunal in June 1990 to look into issues relating to Cauvery river water sharing. After a long struggle by the Tamil Nadu Government, the Cauvery River Water Tribunal issued an interim order on 25 June 1991. The Tribunal has also issued strict orders for release 205 TMC water from Cauvery to Mettur Dam in Tamil Nadu besides fixing the amount of water that is to be released to Tamil Nadu through river Cauvery on weekly and monthly basis. Due to the continuous efforts of Hon. Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu Dr.Puratchithalaivi Amma, the final verdict of Cauvery River Water Tribunal was published in the Union Gazette on 19 February 2013. After the Gazette notification Hon. Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu Dr.Puratchithalaivi Amma in a letter written to the Hon. Prime Minister had requested for setting up of Cauvery Management Board and Cauvery Water Regulatory Authority. Even the Hon. Supreme Court has opined that it is the duty of the Union Government to setup the Cauvery Management Board and Cauvery River Water Monitoring Group. Hon’ble Minister for Water Resources. Due to the insufficient water released through Cauvery to Tamil Nadu during the last two years, water could not be released for agricultural purposes from Mettur Dam as per schedule on 12 June 2015. As a result, the livelihood of several lakhs of farmers has been affected. There has been a considerable loss in Kuruvai rice cultivation in the Cauvery Delta Districts. It has affected the economy of Tamil Nadu as well as the economy of the country. On behalf of Hon. Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu Dr. Puratchithalaivi Amma, on behalf of farmers of Cauvery Delta Region and on my own behalf, I urge upon the Union Minister of Water Resources to completely implement the final verdict of Cauvery River Water Tribunal and protect the legal rights of farmers of the Tamil Nadu by setting up the Cauvery Management Board and Cauvery Water Regulatory Authority very soon. Thank you.

Title: Further discussion on the commitment to India’s constitution as part of 125th birth anniversary celebration of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. 

THE MINISTER OF URBAN DEVELOPMENT, MINISTER OF HOUSING AND URBAN POVERTY ALLEVIATION AND MINISTER OF PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS (SHRI M. VENKAIAH NAIDU): The entire country is watching all of us and keeping that in mind, we should conduct ourselves in the House. If somebody has committed a mistake, they should rectify that. If somebody has done something wrong in the past, they should rectify it themselves. But I feel this is the time, as I was telling yesterday that initially this idea came to me because one of our colleagues in this House Mr. Bhartruhari Mehtab gave this suggestion. Subsequently, some Members also wrote letters to me. Keeping that in mind, we discussed it with the hon. Prime Minister but the Government of India also formed a Committee for celebrations of the birth anniversary of Babasaheb Ambedkar. In that Committee, it was also decided that we must do it in a big way across the country. Then the Government has decided to observe the 26th of November as the Constitution Day. 

We have combined the celebration of both the Constitution and the birth anniversary Babasaheb Ambedkar because he was the chairman of the sub-committee of the constitutional drafting. We have decided to take up this debate. The idea, according to me, is that we should visit the Constituent Assembly debates, the speeches made by the great sons of this great land, what was their vision, what were their expectations and what were the aspirations of the people of the country. Keeping that in mind, we should all assess to what extent we have succeeded in reaching out to those aspirations and expectations. What are the shortcomings, if any, and how to take care of those shortcomings and what are the challenges before us, and then how to address them in future and come with some meaningful suggestions. That was the purpose of this debate. 

Unfortunately, I was a little disappointed. I could not even sleep properly last night because as a Parliamentary Affairs Minister I naturally feel happy when somebody speaks well and makes a good point. The boy Rammohan Naidu, the son of Yerran Naidu, was speaking yesterday. He made a very good speech. A lot of other leaders also have made very good speeches. Even I was so impressed with Soniyaji, the President of Congress Party. Madam Soniyaji, as the President of the Congress Party, has put forth the point of view of the Congress Party. 

I have my disagreement on two observations she made. At the same time I was happy that she was speaking in Hindi. I am a non-Hindi person. … (Interruptions) She was speaking good Hindi. I am a non-Hindi person but I was also feeling okay that things were moving in the right direction. … (Interruptions)

I must tell you frankly I have all admiration for my friend Shri Mallikarjun Kharge but I was a little disappointed in the way he tried to raise certain political issues. पॉलिटिक्स में यह होता रहता है।

Madam today the entire world is looking towards India. I will just first touch some aspects of Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar’s life and then go to other issues.

Born in a common family, Dr. Babasaheb carved a niche for himself on the basis of his brilliant capabilities and intellect braving all shortages, neglect and insults of his time. Now we can say anything but during those days raising a voice and talking about equality and also talking about emancipation of dalits was not an ordinary contribution at that time. The vision he had and the suggestions he gave in the Constituent Assembly are really praiseworthy.

Dr. Ambedkar was a great social warrior at the same time he was a great thinker. He considered the inequalities in the Hindu society as the symbol of civilisational lacuna and dedicated his life to eradicate this incompleteness. The society is not complete without the participation of those people who were oppressed, depressed and suppressed. He was deeply concerned about the people who have been deprived equal opportunities in the society. That is where his greatness lies. He single-handedly lifted millions out of deprivation to dignity. 

There was no place for enmity and hatred in Ambedkar’s political thinking. He was fighting against the dichotomies, contradictions and evils of the society. He was not fighting against any particular religion. He was trying to highlight the shortcomings in the society at that time.

He was truly a national leader and his nationalism was not confined to just transfer of power from British to Indians, but permanent reconstruction of the nation. That was the thrust he had given. उस समय लोगों में यह भावना थी कि अगर आजादी आ गयी, स्वराज आ गया तो स्वराज हो जाएगा, लेकिन उस समय अम्बेडकर जी ने कहा कि आजादी महत्वपूर्ण है, लेकिन आजादी के साथ समानता और सोशल जस्टिस भी महत्वपूर्ण है, उसी के आधार पर देश का पुनर्निर्माण करना चाहिए। यह वि­ाय उन्होंने उस समय कहा था।

He was of the view that for the success of democracy, the role of the Opposition and also of the Media is very important. What role they played is a different matter; the role of the Opposition and the Media is also equally important.

He said in one word that nation building could be considered as a ‘core project’. His concern was nation building. He considered the society and the nation above everything else.

India has been able to reach where it is today because of the solid foundation he provided by laying down the Constitution of India and by working towards the empowerment and upliftment of the dalits. It was not only Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar but the great founding fathers of the Constitution, the first Chairman of the Constituent Assembly Dr. Sachchidananda Sinha and then Dr. Rajendra Prasad; Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru; Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel; Maulana Azad; Krishnaswamy Iyengar; and a lot of other important luminaries who have all worked in the Committee, outside the Committee, and in the main body. All of them worked immensely and laid a better future and good roadmap for all of us through the Constitution they have offered to all of us. Today, we are re-dedicating ourselves and re-committing ourselves to the Constitution, to strengthen the Constitution.

Dr. Ambedkar was not only a constitutional expert of barrister but he was also a great economist. He has done his Ph.D in economics and submitted his thesis on ‘The problem of the rupee, its origins and solutions’. Even now, we are discussing about the problem of the rupee. Fiscal Federalism was the concept he gave in the constitutional scheme of things. He also played a key role in setting up the Reserve Bank of India. Reserve Bank is a pride of our nation. He made immense contribution in shaping the Reserve Bank at that time.

In Viceroy’s Council he held the responsibility of all the important components, labour, employment, coal, minerals and water resources. 

He was also instrumental in setting up Employment Exchanges. The idea of employment exchanges came from Dr. Babasaheb at that time. It was set up by him. 

He was also instrumental in molding the thinking of the people. I would just quote one word here. He talked of ‘socialist principle of State and Government’. He said: 

“The State shall, in particular, direct its policy towards securing 

1 that the citizens, men and women equally, have the right to an adequate means of livelihood (the basic principle);

2 that the ownership and control of the material resources of the community are so distributed as best to sub serve the common good.” 

That is the foundation he has laid.

On 15th  November 1949 socialist pattern of governance was the flavour of the season. He said:

“At this point of time socialist pattern of governance is good but people are free to decide better way than socialism to organise the society.”

This was his vision. At that time nobody was able to say anything against socialism or even in an alternative thought but he visualised the situation and gave that liberty to the people that they are the masters and they can decide. Subsequently in 90s we had the reforms and then we had public sector, private sector, joint sector, PPP model and lately investment from outside also. All these things have come up now and he had envisaged all of them and said that people have the liberty.

He also said:

“‘….What should be the policy of the State, how the Society should be organized in its social and economic side are matters which must be decided by the people themselves according to time and circumstances……”

Please underline ‘according to time and circumstances’. This is the foresight of our constitutional framers.

The most favourite thing for the people of the country, even for people like me also, the proposal of interlinking rivers was his suggestion at that time. गंगा और कावेरी को जोड़ने से देश में सूखा और बाढ़ से जो भयंकर स्थिति बन रही है, उसको दूर किया जा सकता है। मैंने कुछ दिन ग्रामीण विकास मंत्री के रूप में भी काम किया था। देश भर में आप लोग देख रहे हैं कि अर्बनाइजेशन बहुत तेजी से बढ़ रहा है। लोग गांव छोड़ कर शहर में आ रहे हैं। मैं भी ग्रामीण विकास छोड़ कर अब शहरी विकास में पहुंच गया हूं। यह वस्तुस्थिति है। This is the real situation today. So, keeping that in mind, today when we are paying tributes to our constitutional farmers we should also think seriously about that subject which was envisaged by Dr. Babasaheb about interlinking of rivers. Our former Prime Minister, Shri Vajpayee had made a contribution towards this. He set up a Committee under Shri Suresh Prabhu to work out the details of economic viability and technical feasibility of the scheme. They have done their job. Dr. K.L. Rao, during the earlier Government, I think during Indira Ji’s period, came out with a master plan for linking up of rivers. This is one issue which we should remember.

Dr. Ambedkar was also instrumental in realisation of irrigation projects - Damodar Valley, Hirakud, Son River etc. He had his own contribution towards those projects.

His personality, calibre and hard work was realised by everybody during the Constituent Assembly debates and discussion. My friend Shri Kharge yesterday quoted Shri T.T. Krishnamachari. I would like to go in little detail about it. This is for the knowledge of the new generation. Today we are speaking in the House and we are also reminding our new generation about the great qualities and contribution of Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar.

Shri T T Krishnamachari, former Finance Minister and a great economist said and I quote: 

“Mr. President, Sir, I am one of those in the House who have listened to Dr Ambedkar very carefully. I am aware of the amount of work and enthusiasm that he has brought to bear on the work of drafting this Constitution. 

At the same time, I do realise that the amount of attention that was necessary for the purpose of drafting Constitution so important to us at this moment, has not been given to it by the Drafting Committee.” 

He was conceding that. Madam, this is quotation from Mr. Krishnamachari:

“The House is perhaps aware that of the seven members nominated by you, one had resigned from the House and was replaced. One died and was not replaced. One was away in America and his place was not filled up and another person was engaged in State affairs, and there was a void to that extent.

One or two people were far away from Delhi and perhaps reasons of health did not permit them to attend.”

So out of seven, practically many of them could not make it to regular meetings of the Constituent Assembly Sub-Committee. That was the observation made by Krishnamachariji. He said:

“So it happened ultimately that the burden of drafting this constitution fell on Dr. Ambedkar and I have no doubt that we are grateful to him for having achieved this task in a manner which is undoubtedly commendable.”

That was the compliment made at that time. So, we can understand the contribution made by Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar. He was aware that the biggest threat to any nation is internal rather than external. He said it at that time that threat to any nation is first internal than external. In the Constituent Assembly he raised the question that on January 26,1950, we would be a Republic but what would happen to our independence. Taking historical references he reminded the representatives in the House that we had lost independence earlier due to internal weaknesses, and that it was important to see that it does not happen again. This is what he had said at that time. See the vision and foresight of that great man. He also said so many things about caste politics, religion politics, sectarian politics and other things. I do not want to dwell upon that. Some of the people had talked about it yesterday. But he cautioned all of us that such things are going to happen in future and one has to be careful. So, he was truly a national leader in words, deeds and his actions. 

Dr Ambedkar will always be remembered as a leader who worked in letter and spirit to bring social equality and harmony in practice through social transformation. He said that if we as a society continue to deny equality in our social and economic life, then this could one day become a threat to our political democracy. This is the fore-warning he had given to all of us. 

He said that the working of a Constitution does not depend wholly upon the nature of the Constitution. The factors on which the working of those organs of the State depends are the people and the political parties they set upon.

So we have to remember that in this country since our Independence of 68 years, how long have we been in power and what have we done? I am not using this occasion to find fault with this Government or that Government, though some parties have ruled for long and now raising questions. They have every right to raise questions. 

The first thing in my judgment was to do hold fast to constitutional methods of achieving our social and economic objectives. The second thing we must do is to observe the caution that, not "to lay their liberties at the feet of even a great man or a woman, or to trust him with power which enable him to subvert their institutions". Just see his foresight. He visualized that a situation may come like that. ज्यादा से ज्यादा आप ऐसी स्थिति में गये तो देश के लिए क्या होगा, उन्होंने उसके बारे में भी थोड़ा लोगों को कॉशन किया है, चेतावनी दी है। कितना भी महत्वपूर्ण व्यक्ति हो, केवल एक व्यक्ति के हाथ में पूरे अधिकार देने से, उसके सामने झुकने से क्या होगा, उसके बारे में भी उन्होंने कहा है। बाद में क्या होता है, हमने सैवन्टीज में अनुभव भी किया है। इसलिए हम लोगों को इस वि­ाय से बहुत कुछ सीखना है। हमें जागरूक होना चाहिए। 

There is nothing wrong in that. We have icons in this country to adore. Even I adore Swami Vivekananda, Sardar Vallabh Bhai Patel and Subhash Chandra Bose. These are three icons for me. I take my inspiration from the lives, teachings and preachings of these great people. It is not that I do not respect other leaders but if some one asks you who your favourite is, I say that they are these three. Like this, there are many icons in the country of different shades and opinions. Right from the freedom movement also there were श्री गोपाल कृ­ण गोखले, पंडित मदन मोहन मालवीय, श्री बाल गंगाधर तिलक से लेकर महात्मा गांधी, नेहरू जी, पटेल जी, सुभा­ा चंद्र बोस जी, श्री भगत सिंह, सुखदेव, राजगुरू और हमारे इलाके में अल्लूर सीताराम राजू, तमिलनाडु में वीरपांडिय कट्टबोम्मन ऐसे बहुत लोगों ने देश को प्रेरणा दी। अभी आप लोगों को आश्चर्य होगा, देश में एक दुर्भाग्य यह भी है कि जहां-जहां कोने-कोने से होता है, उन लोगों को नेशनल लैवल पर जितनी इम्पार्टेंस देनी चाहिए, उतनी इम्पार्टेंस नहीं दी है। इसलिए मैं देख रहा हूं जब मैंने वीरपांडिय कट्टबोम्मन का नाम लिया, पसुम्पोन मुत्थूरामलिंग थेवर का नाम लिया तो हमारे तमिल भाई मेजे थपथपाते हैं, बाकी लोगों के लिए वीरपांडिय कट्टबोम्मन कौन है, उनका कंट्रीब्यूशन क्या है, यह मालूम नहीं है। बाकी को लोगों को पता नहीं है कि वीरापांडय़ा कट्टाबोमन कौन हैं, उनका कंट्रिब्यूशन क्या है, वह लोगों को मालूम नहीं है। Adoor Sitaram Raju fought the Britishers single-handedly and mobilised the tribals. These are the people who gave us inspiration and they had the foresight and they had shown the way to us. I respect my leaders Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee and Shri Lal Krishna Advani. But I can tell you today that they taught us how to raise questions. We follow the leader because of their policies and principles that have been laid down. This has to be kept in mind. Nowadays some people are talking about personality cult forgetting that they themselves have cultivated the cult, built the cult, developed the cult and became the casualty of the cult. They are giving advice to us. There is a saying that we should learn from the experience of others. We will keep that in mind. 

SHRI MALLIKARJUN KHARGE (GULBARGA): You are doing the same thing. 

SHRI M. VENKAIAH NAIDU: We will never do the same thing. You do not worry about that. You have to appreciate the fact that if you have a leader with character, calibre, capacity, conduct, discipline, dynamism, devotion and dedication, you must give hats off to that leader. We are proud to have a leader. It is not only Venkaiah Naidu who is saying this. The entire world is saying that Modi is the maker of developed India. How can anybody deny this? It is not here in Delhi. You go to Madison Square in America; you go to France; you go to Germany; you go to Japan; you go to China; you go to Nepal, you go to anywhere except this block sitting in front of me, the entire world is saying is Modi, Modi and Modi… (Interruptions) I can understand that you cannot tolerate the verdict of the people. I can understand that… (Interruptions) इस देश में बिहार एक प्रदेश है। बड़ा प्रदेश है और उससे भी सीखना चाहिए। मगर उसके बाद आप लोगों को क्या हुआ, थोड़ा उस पर भी ध्यान दीजिए। अभी मुझे डायवर्ट मत कीजिए। कारण क्या है कि मेरे पास बताने के लिए बहुत वि­ाय हैं। 

Dr. Ambedkar’s fundamental concern was to liberate the untouchables, the depressed classes, women and minorities from the menace of social oppression, the provisions of positive discrimination. There was a suggestion on the atrocities on the people belonging to the Scheduled Castes; there was also a suggestion about reservation in the private sector; then there was a suggestion about reservation in promotion. These are the issues that we have to discuss. It is not as simple as one Minister standing up and saying yes. If it would have been that simple then Shri Kharge ji and his Government would have done it long back. There are problems and there are forces in the country. People talk about reservation of women. But why is it then not coming? 

SHRI MALLIKARJUN KHARGE: We have done it and therefore we are saying.

SHRI M. VENKAIAH NAIDU: Kharge ji, you have done everything. You spoke for 72 minutes, almost equivalent to your age. 

SHRI MALLIKARJUN KHARGE: That was the courtesy extended by the hon. Speaker. If you would have been there you would not have allowed me even two minutes. 

SHRI M. VENKAIAH NAIDU: At least he has that much appreciation for the hon. Speaker. I am thankful to him. He is respecting the institution. 

The next point is positive affirmative action. The other day in the All Party Meeting my friend Shri Sitaram Yechury also was saying कल भी मेरे ख्याल से त्रिपुरा से चौधरी जी ने बोला है, मैं हरेक का पॉइंट्स नोट कर रहा हूँ। ऍफर्मेटिव एक्शन होना चाहिए। It should not be a simple occasion like putting up a photo हमारे इलाके में कहते हैं कि साल में एक बार याद रखना और फिर बाद में भूल जाना, वह नहीं है, यह सब गंभीर मामला है, इसके साथ और भी वि­ाय हैं, मैं उन वि­ायों पर आने वाला हूँ। 

Dr. B.R. Ambedkar said that the purpose of education is to moralise and socialise the people. Then he said that education is the nucleus of democracy to emancipate the society. Every word which he has said is a golden word. Dr. Ambedkar was more concerned about the character-building of the people. 

“Education was a sword and being a double-edged weapon was dangerous to wield. An educated man without character and humility was more dangerous than a beast. If his education was detrimental to the welfare of the poor, the educated man was a curse to the society. Character is more important than education.”

कभी-कभी हमको हमारे नेता श्री आडवाणी जी याद दिलाते रहते हैं कि आइडियालिजी महत्वपूर्ण है। आइडियालिजी से भी महत्वपूर्ण आइडियल बिहैव है। आचरण बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, ऐसा हमेशा वे हमें कहते रहे हैं। फेडरल गवर्नमेंट के बारे में भी उन्होंने कहा कि देश में यूनिफार्मिटी इन फंडामेंटल लॉस होना चाहिए। This is not what the BJP is saying. This is what Dr. Ambedkar said. He said about uniformity in fundamental laws including civil and criminal laws. This is what he had suggested at that time but the country is yet to reach that. Directive Principles also speak of the same. The country is yet to move in that direction. The Supreme Court also said that there is a need for a common Civil Code. But still we are far away from that. 

Today, I have seen that around 70,000 women have given a petition to the Prime Minister about the need of gender equality. A petition is also pending before the court. The moment somebody talks about it, some people will say that we are interfering in the personal laws of persons. What personal law prevents a woman being in equality with man? I am not able to understand this so far. We have to introspect on that issue also. Unfortunately, cautions were given by him. At that time also, there was a three-and-a-half years fight for Hindu Code Bill and it was for the same objective. When he realized that the Hindu Code Bill was not going to be passed, he resigned from the Cabinet. He resigned not because of his personal differences with Pandit Ji. It was due to his differences on larger issues that he thought that his approach was good for the country and the Government of that day thought otherwise. So, he did not even take minutes to resign and go out of the Cabinet. Nowadays, we are seeing the situation on going out of the Cabinet and how people keep moving from the morning, evening and afternoon from one party to another party and sometimes people break parties also.… (Interruptions) That being the case, he never bothered about going out of the Cabinet also alongwith Shri Shyama Prasad Mukherjee, the great son of this great country. They were great people. Let us agree to disagree but let us debate and then go to the people. People are the ultimate judges. They decide what to do and what not to do. Why should we worry about it? Shri Mukherjee differed with somebody. It is true. That is the beauty of democracy. Even in a family, there will be differences of opinion sometimes but at the end of it, we come to some conclusion and then move forward. 

Madam, unfortunately, the cautions were overlooked by the earlier regimes. What happened in India during the last 50 years of rule? The earlier regime is bending and mending the ways to overlook the Constitutional methods to achieve their political objectives rather than social objectives. 

I will come to certain issues now. I am sharing my concern not as a Minister for Parliamentary Affairs but as Venkaiah Naidu and as an individual. What are the people of India thinking? People of India are very intelligent. Please understand this. 

Yesterday, when the Vice President of the Congress Party went to Bengaluru and asked questions, you may find the wisdom of the young girls. How they reacted and spoke on various issues? I am not here to criticize Rahul Ji or anybody. That is not my purpose. My purpose is to say that the children of the country also are seriously and keenly observing as to what is happening in the country. They know what is good and what is not good. Let us not underestimate the wisdom of the people. 

.

श्री मल्लिकार्जुन खड़गे : क्या यह वि­ाय से कन्सर्न है? ...(व्यवधान)

माननीय अध्यक्ष : ऐसा बार-बार नहीं करते हैं। He has not said anything objectionable.

…(व्यवधान)

श्री एम. वैंकैय्या नायडू : इतने अनुभव के बाद भी आपको यह सहन नहीं है तो मैं क्या करूँ खड़गे जी?  

What about literacy? What did the Constitution Framer said about it? He said that there has to be total literacy. Where are we today? Even today, 36 per cent of the people of India cannot read and write. Is it not a matter for the entire country and for all of us in Parliament to think about? I am not blaming anybody like they have ruled for a long period and they have more account. I am not going into that. What I am saying is that we should ponder over that issue. 

There is Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan. Educating all our children was the wish of our founding fathers. But where do we stand today? That one question we have to ask ourselves.

Second issue is the female foeticide. You see the sex ratio. … (Interruptions) Shri Kharge, please allow me. … (Interruptions) मेरी पार्टी का समय छः घंटे है, फिर भी मैं 72 मिनट के आगे एक मिनट भी नहीं जाऊँगा।...(व्यवधान) 

Female foeticide and the sex ratio is really worrisome. That is why we have to think about that. 

In spite of all these years of civilization, dowry menace is rampant in the country. Can you simply ban it through legislation? We also need to have political and social will. We have to rise above these and then think about the social evils also.

The fourth is untouchability. In spite of all the laws that we have passed and irrespective of which party was in power, still untouchability is practised in certain areas even today. Untouchability is practiced even today in some of the places of worship. Some people felt happy to convert to other religions. There also they complain of the same practice. वहाँ भी ऐसी स्थिति है, इसलिए हमें वहाँ भी आरक्षण दें, ऐसा भी लोग देश में कह रहे हैं। इसलिए यह गंभीर मसला है। इसके साथ ही महिलाओं पर जो अत्याचार हो रहे हैं, मेरी सरकार के समय कितने हुए, आपकी सरकार के समय में कितने हुए, स्टेट्स में कितने हुए, नेशनल कैपिटल में कितने हुए, यह फिगर देने से क्या मतलब है? इस देश में जो निर्भया प्रकरण हुआ, दिल्ली में, देश की राजधानी में, वह हम सबके लिए शर्म की बात है। 

We have to seriously engage ourselves to find out ways and means of creating the needed awareness among the people. We have to particularly change the mindset of men. That is also another important task we should remember today when we are doing introspection. 

Another problem is caste and communal politics. There are some people who try to raise a controversy about what our senior leader, Shri Rajnath Singh, has said yesterday. People who practice caste politics, people who practice communal politics, people who practice parochial politics call others as anti-secular. That is why he said that ‘secularism’ is the most abused word in this country. Nobody has got any doubt about secularism. कांस्टीटय़ूशन में है, कांस्टीटय़ूशन में रहेगा, मगर लोगों के दिल में है, दिल में रहेगा और आगे बढ़ेगा, यह मेरा कहना है। नहीं तो केवल कानून बनाने से काम नहीं होगा, आदर्श ऊपर रखने से काम नहीं होगा। जब आदर्श पर अमल करते हैं, उसी दिशा में आगे बढ़ते हैं, जब आप अपने बच्चों को, नई पीढ़ी को प्रोत्साहित करते हैं, उनमें जागृति पैदा करते हैं, तभी आदर्श का उद्देश्य सफल होगा, यह मेरा कहना है।

Next issue is the influence of money power in elections. We are all trying to be hypocritical about money power. How much money is being spent by candidates who are contesting elections? All of us are filing Income Tax Returns and the Election Commission Returns. That is a different matter. But actually how much are we spending? Let us search our souls and find out what is happening. People have to vote on the basis of character, calibre, capacity and conduct and not on the basis of caste, money or religion. This has to be highlighted and we must create awareness among the people. लोग इनको छोड़कर वोट कर रहे हैं, मैं उनको सलामी कर रहा हूँ। मगर कभी कभी क्या होता है कि इस देश में जातिवाद पर भी लोग कभी कभी किसी न किसी तरीके से लोगों को भ्रमित करने का काम करते हैं। इस देश का एक दुर्भाग्य है। मैं अपना छोटा सा अनुभव बता रहा हूँ - ज़मीन, जल, भा­ाा और मज़हब कभी कभी लोगों को इतना उद्वेलित और भ्रमित करते हैं कि लोग उसके प्रभाव में आकर लोगों को जो भी करना है, करते हैं और बाद में रियलाइज़ करते हैं। एक बार हो गया तो पाँच साल कुछ नहीं कर पाते। तो मनी पावर को कैसे कम करना है, इसके बारे में भी सोचना चाहिए। 

My next issue is the growing opportunism and defections. This is another worrisome issue. We have banned the retail defections. But now wholesale defections are going on. Yesterday I saw in one of the States in the country, in the North-East, all the Members have joined the ruling party. I do not want to name any party. … (Interruptions) 

ठीक है, हमारा एलाइ है, किसका एलाइ है, बाद में मालूम हो जाएगा। ...(व्यवधान) उसमें कांग्रेस भी शामिल हो गई, बीजेपी भी शामिल हो गई, मैं उसमें नहीं जा रहा हूँ। आज थोड़ा उससे हटकर मैं बोलना चाहता था, इसलिए मैं कह रहा हूँ। यह गंभीर मामला है। स्टेट्स में भी क्या हो रहा है। हमने संविधान में संशोधन लाकर कहा और लैजिस्लेटिव मीज़र्स के द्वारा कहा कि कैबिनेट इससे ज्यादा नहीं होनी चाहिए। उससे ज्यादा नहीं होने को आपने प्रतिबंधित कराया। फिर बाद में क्या हुआ - पार्लियामैंट्री सैक्रेटरी बनाओ, या मिनिस्टर का दर्जा दो, यह देश में सब जगह हो रहा है। यह सब पार्टियों की कमज़ोरी है। 

सर, वहां एलाऊ किया, हमको भी करना चाहिए, समाज में विभिन्न वर्ग हैं, सब को प्रतिनिधित्व देना चाहिए, नहीं तो विभिन्न रीजंस हैं, सब-रीजंस हैं, रिलिजियंस हैं, सब-रिलिजियंस हैं, ऐसा करके प्रतिनिधि के रूप में कैबिनेट में पहुंचना और जनता के ऊपर बोझ डालना, is it not a matter for all of us, as a mature democracy, to discuss this situation and come out with some sort of a solution? When, Advaniji was the Home Minister, he brought a legislation to the effect that not more than 10 per cent of the Assembly and not more than 15 per cent of both the Houses of Legislature put together could be made Ministers. That is working well. But these exceptions have come up. This has to be thought of. पार्लियामेंट में भी यह स्थिति है और अगर प्रदेश में अलग-अलग पार्टियों की सरकार है, वह भी देश में एक सौजन्य है। कोई भी पार्टी सत्ता से बाहर नहीं है, कहीं न कहीं प्रदेश में है और केन्द्र में रही है, इसलिए हम लोगों का अनुभव जो हमारे सामने है, हम आंख बन्द करके यह नहीं कह सकते कि सब ठीक चल रहा है। आपके बारे में मैं आलोचना करूं, मेरे बारे में आप आलोचना करें तो यह हो जायेगा, एक दिन हैडलाइन हो जायेगी, मगर लोगों की मेन लाइन है न, उस लाइन में कोई परिवर्तन नहीं होगा। Growing opportunism and defection is a big worry. I can tell you, from day one when I joined politics, when I started writing on the walls and then tying the party flag on the pole and used to announce the arrival of Atal Bihari Vajpayee and Advani to my place, I never imagined that from there I can reach this stage and then sit between Atal Bihari Vajpayee and Advani and become the National President of the Party. One reason what I feel is I am consistent with my ideology. That really helps also. One has to understand this. We are there in politics for a mission, not for commission. This has to be understood by one and all.

Then, defection is a cancer to the society. Some of our friends, they are also casualties because people have affection towards defection and they are trying to make a perfection out of it. That is another worry. We have to think about the country. There are regional disparities. People are asking for giving special status to their States. Every State is asking for a special status now. Why? We have to think about it. I am not criticizing anybody. Even I have asked for special status for Andhra Pradesh on the floor of the Parliament because I thought that Andhra Pradesh was discriminated upon and they were not getting their due with regard to revenue share, not because of other parameters. बाद में 14वां फाइनेंस कमीशन आया, 14वें कमीशन ने रिपोर्ट दी, उसके ऊपर बहस हो रही है, मगर बिहार मांग रहा है, वैस्ट बंगाल मांग रहा है, उड़ीसा मांग रहा है और जो डैवलप्ड स्टेट्स हैं, वे लोग भी मांग रहे हैं। पंजाब कह रहा है कि हमारे बारे में क्या है। Where do you go? Yesterday Ram Vilasji was saying that now there is a race for demanding special status.

श्री जय प्रकाश नारायण यादव (बाँका) : यह तो हमारा हक है। बिहार के लिए स्पेशल स्टेटस मिलना चाहिए।...(व्यवधान)

श्री एम. वैंकैय्या नायडू : ठीक है, यह आपका हक है। देश में हरेक नागरिक का अपना हक है, दूसरे लोगों का हक भी है और दूसरे लोगों के हक को कैसे मैनेज करना, यह हमारा हक है, हमारा दायित्व बनता है।...(व्यवधान)

श्री जय प्रकाश नारायण यादव : इस हक को नहीं माना गया है, इसलिए बिहार को स्पेशल स्टेटस मिलना चाहिए।...(व्यवधान)

माननीय अध्यक्ष : जी, बैठिये।

श्री एम. वैंकैय्या नायडू : जयप्रकाश जी, ऐसा कटाक्ष करने से कुछ होगा नहीं, यह तादाद तो देवता यहां नहीं रहेंगे, कहां ऊपर डोम है।...(व्यवधान) अरे भई, इसके पहले क्या हुआ, स्पेशल स्टेटस क्यों नहीं दिया, आप लोग ही राज में थे। इसलिए उसमें मत पड़िये। कश्मीर की स्थिति थोड़ी अलग है, वहां को सपोर्ट करना चाहिए और कुछ स्टेट्स की जो बैकवर्डनैस है, धीरे-धीरे उस बैकवर्डनैस से बाहर आ रहे हैं, झारखण्ड, बैकवर्डनैस से बाहर आ रहे हैं, ईवन छत्तीसगढ़, बैकवर्डनैस से बाहर आ रहे हैं, उड़ीसा और नैचुरल जो मिनरल रिसोर्सेज़ हैं, उन रिसोर्सेज़ का डिवोल्यूशन भी संविधान निर्माताओं ने उस समय जो कहा, फैडरल सिस्टम में। फैडरल सिस्टम का वह डिवोल्यूशन आज इस सरकार ने करके दिखाया, इसलिए आपने देखा होगा, मैडम, शुरू में जब यह माइन्स एण्ड मिनरल्स बिल आया, काफी लोगों ने विरोध किया। बाद में जब बातचीत हुई तो देखा कि स्टेट्स को फायदा हो रहा है तो लोगों ने सपोर्ट किया। यह अलग बात है कि इन लोगों ने उसकी आलोचना की, आप लोगों ने प्रभाव में आकर उसको सपोर्ट किया, पहले आपके प्रभाव में आये क्या, सपोर्ट नहीं करने के लिए? वह इश्यू नहीं है। मेरा कहना यह है कि संवाद का दायरा बहुत से वि­ायों को सुलझा सकता है। Another issue is asking for the status of Backward Class, then asking for Most Backward Class, then asking for the status of Scheduled Caste and then asking for the status of Scheduled Tribe….

रामदास अठावले जी ने ऑल पार्टी मीटिंग में सलाह दी। उन्होंने कहा कि इससे बेहतर होगा कि सभी देशवासियों को शत प्रतिशत आरक्षण दीजिए। क्या आरक्षण देने से ही सबका संरक्षण होगा? ऐसा नहीं है न? क्या वह एक सॉल्यूशन हो सकता है? इसे देखना चाहिए। इस पर चर्चा करनी चाहिए। People should think about it. As far as we are concerned, the Government has said it very clearly that they are in favour of giving reservation. They are in favour of extending it as long as it is necessary for the suppressed and depressed people. That is the commitment of the Constitution. That is the commitment of our party. Over and above, there should also be enough reservation for women. I remember, as a Party President, our leader Shri Advaniji had moved the Resolution from the Chair in the BJP meeting at Baroda. जब मैं पहली बार इस पार्टी में आया, तो कुछ लोगों ने मेरा मज़ाक उड़ाया और कहा कि वेंकैया नायडू, आप उस पार्टी में जा रहे हैं, यह उत्तर भारतीय पार्टी है, यह पढ़े-लिखे लोगों की पार्टी है, शहरी लोगों की पार्टी है, और अन्त में कहा कि यह शाकाहारी लोगों की पार्टी है। 

मैडम, मैं इसे फ्रैंक्ली शेयर करना चाहता हूं कि मेरे मन में थोड़ा-सा आया कि यह क्या है? बाद में जाकर मैंने अपने सीनियर से यह पूछा, तो उन्होंने कहा कि ऐसी कोई आपत्ति नहीं है। आप अंडा खा सकते हैं, मुर्गी खा सकते हैं, उसकी मां को भी खा सकते हैं, कोई प्रॉब्लम नहीं है। मैं खाने लगा और अभी भी खाता हूं। यह लोगों में गलतफहमी है। 

अभी क्या स्थिति है? एक ज़माने में हम लोग कभी भी साउथ में जीतते नहीं थे। आज कन्याकुमारी में बीजेपी. का झंडा है, कश्मीर में बीजेपी का झंडा है। नागालैंड में बीजेपी का झंडा है, अंडमान में बीजेपी का झंडा है। पहले मेनलैंड, बाद में आईलैंड, यानी अंडमान। फिर बाद में हिललैंड, लद्दाख में भी बीजेपी है और नागालैंड में भी है। सब मिलाकर हम यहां तक पहुंच गए और ऑल इंडिया पार्टी बन गए। सबसे ज्यादा शिडय़ूल्ड कास्ट्स के एम.पी. हमारे पास हैं, शिडय़ूल्ड ट्राइब्स एम.पी. हमारे पास हैं, महिला एम.पी. हमारे पास हैं। ...(व्यवधान) 

अभी केरल के म्युनिसिपल इलेक्शन में भी हम लोगों ने देखा। आप तीसरे स्थान पर पहुंच गए और हम दूसरे स्थान पर पहुंच गए।...(व्यवधान) सलीम भाई की पार्टी की थोड़ी दया की वज़ह से हमें थोड़ा प्रोत्साहन मिला है।...(व्यवधान)

Madam, we have to now focus on women’s reservation. If women’s reservation is so simple, why are we hesitating? They are asking as to why we are hesitating. Our people are asking as to why they have hesitated. People are asking as to why both of you are hesitating.… (Interruptions) They are hesitating and we are hesitating. This is an issue where everybody has to put their palm on their chests. People feel that if 33 per cent will be given, तो आगे के लिए हमारी सीटें कैसे आएंगी? इसके बारे में भी आपस में थोड़ा-सा डायलॉग की जरूरत है। डायलॉग करके हमें आगे बढ़ना चाहिए। इस बीच हमारे पास महिला प्रतिनिधि और मित्र आए थे। उन्होंने कहा कि इसे जल्दी से जल्दी आगे ले जाना चाहिए। सचमुच में इसे आगे ले जाना चाहिए। इसका कारण यह है कि कुछ इलाकों में पंचायत में 50औ महिला आरक्षण है, कुछ इलाकों में म्युनिसिपैलिटी में 50औ महिला आरक्षण है। वे अच्छा काम कर रही हैं। कुछ लोग इसकी अवहेलना कर सकते हैं कि अब यह पंचायतपति हो गया। क्या पति हमेशा ठीक व्यवहार करते हैं? हम पुरु­ा लोग यहां पहुंच गए हैं। उनमें से कितने लोग स्कैम्स में, स्कैण्डल्स में फंस गए। केवल महिला लोगों को आप दो­ा क्यों देते हैं? उन्हें मौका दीजिए। आप लोगों ने इतने साल शासन किया। उन्हें भी कुछ दिन अच्छे काम करने का मौका दीजिए। In view of this, we have to think about the Reservation Bill and we must come to a conclusion because we have been talking about it but we have not been working about it. Mere talking is not going to help us so, we also need to work. 

Then, there is stopping of criminalization in politics. This is another important issue which is being debated in TV channels across the country. Then, Manmohanji wanted to bring some legislation at that time. It could not happen. There was serious protest within the Congress Party also. A big debate is going on in the society also. Even about the recent elections people are coming with figures as to how many MLAs in that particular State have that background. 

12.00 hours

People are coming up with figures as to how many politicians belong to this party, how many of them belong to that party. Whatever party it may be, but they belong to a political party. So, that is a concern for all of us. We have to address this issue as to how to prevent the criminal elements from entering into politics. This is another topic for discussion and introspection amongst ourselves. 

Then, eradicating corruption, which is eating into the vitals of the nation, is very important. करप्शन कितना है, मैं उसमें नहीं जाना चाहता हूं। पुराने टू जी, थ्री जी या हां जी में मैं नहीं जाना चाहता हूं। मेरा कहना यह है कि corruption has become an important issue, which is agitating the minds of the people at national level, at State level, at local level, at individual level. All of us have to apply our mind and see to it that the money should reach the people. The late Shri Rajiv Gandhi once said: “If I send Rs.100 from Delhi, only Rs. 15 reaches the beneficiaries.” It was more on account of agony and not to criticise , anybody that he made this comment. It is about the money reaching the lowest level. That is why, now, we have to think of new ways like Direct Benefit Transfer on Scholarship, Subsidy, Gas Subsidy, Fertilizer Subsidy, PDS Subsidy, Pensions. Can we think of totally transferring them into the bank account of the beneficiaries? That is why the hon. Prime Minister said JAM ( Jan Dhan Yojana, AADHAR Card and Mobile Card) is the way by which we can improve our system. A lot of States are doing it. Our friends from Hyderabad have done some good experiments with regard to Hyderabad revenues. Their revenues have improved through a system. Now, every State is competing. Andhra Pradesh Government is also coming up with a new technology. Now, here, some other Government has also come up with some new App also. 

So, all these things should be pursued vigorously to see that the public money that is being spent by the Government of India and the State Governments reaches the needy and is not allowed to be lapsed in between. That should be the priority for our discussion.

Another thing is ‘focus on growing fundamentalism.’ Yes, some people are making statements. Some people are making statements here and some people are going leisurely to the neighbouring country and making statements there also. My point is that fringe elements of any side should be isolated. For each and every thing, now people start saying that आपके जमाने में हुआ, हमारा जमाना तो अभी-अभी आया है, आपका जमाना कितने साल रहा, उसके बारे में क्या हुआ? इसके बारे में भी लोग चर्चा करेंगे। 

Shed pseudo secular attitude. Let there be no appeasement of anybody. ‘Justice for all, appeasement of none’ should be the policy. That is the true meaning of सर्वधर्म संभावना हिंदी में, हमारे दक्षिण में हम लोग बताते हैं, हिंदी में यहां पंथनिरपेक्षता कहते हैं। ...(व्यवधान) पंथ का नाम लेने में मुझे पंत जी याद आता है, इसलिए मैं थोड़ा संकोच करता हूं। Dharma is different from Religion. Religion is a way of worship but Dharma is our culture, which our forefathers have given to us. आदि काल से, वेद काल से, पुराण काल से हमारे पूर्वजों ने जो जिया और दिया, विरासत में जो हमको मिला, वही धर्म है और सभी देश भारत की प्रशंसा कर रहे हैं। 

अभी नई टेन्डेंसी आई, देश-दुनिया भर में एक नया खतरा आया। पहले केवल आईएसआई से खतरा था। आईएसआईएस इसको भी यस कहने वाले कुछ लोग तैयार हैं। इसलिए उसको भी गंभीरता से लेना चाहिए। उसके लिए क्या-क्या कदम उठाने चाहिए, कौन सा नया कानून लाना चाहिए, क्या सिस्टम होना चाहिए, उसके बारे में दुनिया भर के लोगों में पब्लिक ओपीनियन क्रिएट करने के लिए क्या करना चाहिए, इसके बारे में भी हमें गंभीरता से सोचना चाहिए। 

महोदया, मेरा कहना यह है कि जो-जो हमारे संविधान निर्माताओं ने कहा, उन सभी के ऊपर आज की सरकार वर्तमान में ध्यान दे रही है। मैं डिटेल में नहीं जाना चाहता हूँ। 

Madam, social welfare was talked about earlier. Now, the Government’s focus is more on social security. You have seen in the history of India, for the first time, as per the spirit of the Constitution, as per the preachings and teachings of Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedekar, following the same, our hon. Prime Minister has introduced the Jan Dhan Yojana. Opening of 18 crore to 19 crore bank accounts in five months is a world record. This is to empower the poor people, the ordinary people… (Interruptions) कुछ अच्छा काम यूपीए ने किया तो उसकी सराहना करने में किसी को कोई आपत्ति नहीं है। आप धीरे-धीरे करते रहे, हमने तेजी से उसको आगे बढ़ाया इतना फर्क है। पाँच महीने में 18 करोड़ नए बैंक अकाउंट खोलना कोई मामूली वि­ाय नहीं है। किसी को ओवरटाइम नहीं दिया। किसी के ऊपर दवाब नहीं डाला। ...(व्यवधान) 

Now also, for Direct Benefit Transfer, a lot of money will go to those bank accounts also and bank accounts will be vibrant. … (Interruptions) Have some patience Jyoti, you are an youngster, you have a promising future also. Why are you joining Suresh? … (Interruptions) I do not want him to be totally silent but do not be violent. इतना ही मेरा रिक्वेस्ट है। मेरा कहना यह है कि प्रधानमंत्री जन सुरक्षा योजना, जीवन बीमा योजना, अटल पेंशन योजना Mudra Bank. What are these? These are all as per the vision of Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar reaching out the suppressed and depressed people by giving them a helping hand.

It is because of LPG Liberalisation, Privatisation and Globalisation, a new situation is developing across the globe. In India also, things are changing. So, keeping that in mind, while trying to create wealth, while trying to invite investment, at the same time, you have to take care of the vulnerable sections. That is why, Beti Bachao Beti Padhao; Sukanya Samridhi Yojana; Jan Dhan Yojana; Jan Suraksha Yojana; Jan Shri Bima Yojana; Atal Pension Yojana; and then, Mudra Yojana. 

What is Mudra Yojana? Mudra yojana is not for the rich people. Banks were giving money earlier to the rich people. It is not wrong because money has to come back also. But poor people are more sincere in repaying the loan. I can tell you out of my experience. In Andhra Pradesh and in Telangana, ninety nine percent is the repayment capacity of the self help groups. सहायता समूह का रिपेमेन्ट 99 प्रतिशत है। उसको ध्यान में रख कर प्रधानमंत्री जी ने मुद्रा बैंक की योजना लागू किया है, गरीब लोगों, छोटे लोगों, ऑटोवालों, टैक्सीवालों, फल बेचनेवालों और इडली-ढोसा जो सड़क के किनारे बेचते हैं, उनको लोन कौन देंगे? 

Madam, it is not exaggeration to say that some of our friends, if they forget political differences, will endorse it that in certain markets people give the loan for one thousand in the morning but they will give only nine hundred as cash. The loan is for one thousand rupees. By evening, after you sell your products, you have to pay one thousand rupees. That means the seller has to pay one hundred rupees as interest for one day. That is the situation. That is the exploitation going on. It is not because of any party but it is because of the system. So, keeping that in mind, the Prime Minister came with this novel idea of Mudra Bank Yojana. So, we should see to it that all of us participate in that and see to it that the Mudra Bank Yojana reaches the people. 

What is the atmosphere? I am not going into the details of atrocities. आपके जमाने में कितना हुआ, हमारे जमाने में कम हुआ, ऐसा कहने की मेरी कोई इच्छा भी नहीं है, मेरे पास आंकड़े हैं। Our performance is always better than your performance. The question is that people want total stoppage of atrocities on weaker sections and atrocities on women. That is the aspirations of the people. But this will take time and we are doing our best. What is happening? Some people are saying as if everything has gone wrong only after this Government has come. Some people who went to public and issued statements on the eve of elections saying that Mr. Modi is a fascist, you reject him, people rejected those fascists and they selected and elected Narendra Modi Ji with a massive mandate. Those people could not do anything because they lost the election. They are waiting for an opportunity. As and when there is an election in the country whether be it Delhi election, whether be it Bihar election, they raise their head and say यह खतरे में है। टॉलरैंस खतरे में है। कुछ लोग युनाइटेड नेशन में गये, कुछ लोग अमेरिका अध्यक्ष के पास गये, कुछ लोगों ने लंदन प्राइम मिनिस्टर को भी पत्र लिखा कि मोदी जी को यह-वह नहीं दें। आपको लंदन की असेम्बली में सुंदर दृश्य देखने को मिला होगा। 

Seventy thousand people came to hear the Prime Minister of India. At no time and nowhere in the history such a thing has happened. SHRI MALLIKARJUN KHARGE: What is your contribution? You were nowhere. … (Interruptions)
