The House is discussing our commitment to India's Constitution as part of the 125th birth Anniversary of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. In these times of great political turbulence, our commitment to India's Constitution needs to be reinforced more than ever in the recent history of our country.

66 years ago, on 26th Nov. 1949, the longest written and the most elaborate constitution of any sovereign country in the world, consisting of almost 80,000 words, was adopted in this great country after great deliberation. The drafting Committee of the Constituent Assembly, under the Chairman Shri Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar, took almost 3 years ( 2 years, 11 months and 17 days to be precise) to complete its historic task of drafting the Constitution for independent India. In comparison, American Constitution was drafted in 4 months while Australian Constitution took 9 years.

7,635 amendments to this Draft Constitution were tabled out of which 2,473 amendments were actually moved in the House.

At the time of commencement, the Constitution had 395 articles in 22 parts and 8 schedules. The Constitution, in its current form has 25 parts containing 448 articles, 12 schedules, and 5 appendices.

The progressive vision and the intellectual prowess of the makers of the Constitution can be judged from the fact in the last 66 years, only about 100 amendments have been made to the Constitution of India, the last one being the territory swap agreement with Bangladesh.

Sometimes I wonder if Ambedkar Ji were to be present today, how disappointed and shocked he would have been to the see the intolerant India of present times deeply divided on caste and communal lines. We need to look no further than his speech in the Constituent Assembly on 25th November 1949, 66 years ago. It's absolutely amazing how his words are relevant today than ever, 66 years since they were said. He said : That I was not prepared to accept some suggestions do not diminish the value of suggestions nor lessen the service rendered to the Assembly in enlivening its proceedings. But for those members, I would not have had the opportunity which I got for expounding the principles underlying the Constitution which was more important than the mere mechanical work of passing the Constitution. 

In contrast, the Government of today thinks that majority in the Lok Sabha means they can bulldoze their way without any communication, let alone any effort to build consensus. This is well reflected in the Government's decisions of not appointing any leader of opposition or bypassing Parliament by promulgating 14 ordinances in 1 single year. 

On upholding the commitment to Constitution and Parliamentary democracy. Sh. B.R. Ambedkar said, in his speech in the Constituent Assembly on 25th November, 1949. "It is not that India did not know what Democracy is (as in, in historical times). This democratic system India lost. But it is quite possible in a country like India -where democracy from its long disuse must be regarded as something quite new-there is danger of democracy giving place to dictatorship."

He suggested that if we wish to maintain democracy not merely in form, but also in fact, we must do these three things- "The first thing is to hold fast to constittutional methods of achieving our social and economic objectives. It means abandoning the bloody methods of revolution. When constitutional methods are open, there can be no justification for unconstitutional methods. These methods are nothing but the Grammar of Anarchy."

Simply put, Dr. Ambedkar wanted India, since it was now ruled by Indians, to be governed by the rule of law. The rule of law implies that the citizens are granted rights with reasonable restrictions. This doesn't mean the Government of the day continuously preaching us what to do, what to eat, what to study and what to watch.

He talked about making our political democracy a social democracy as well. His words were-"Social democracy means a way of life which recognises liberty, equality and fraternity as the principles of life."

Additionally, the Preamble to the Constitution talks about socialist and secular ethos. Liberty implies freedom of thought, expression, belief, faith and worship. In contrast, today anyone differing from the Government's opinion is asked to go to Pakistan. Continuous attempts are made to denigrate some citizens as second class in their own country. Standing up for secular rights of the citizens is termed as "pseudosecularism" or "sickularism".

The last thing, Dr. Ambedkar, said was "not to lay liberties at the feet of even a great man, or to trust him with powers which enable him to subvert their institutions. This caution is far more necessary in the case of India than in the case of any other country. For in India, Bhakti or what may be called the path of devotion or hero-worship, plays a part in its politics unequalled in magnitude by the part it plays in the politics of any other country in the world. In politics, Bhakti is a sure road to degradation and to eventual dictatorship.

Compare this to the present times, where the Chief of the Government, the Prime Minister, is concerned with primarily addressing his "bhakts" constitutency. Gruesome communal incidents happen in this country. Bhakts, within and outside the government, try to justify his silence and anyone asking questions is labeled anti national. The PM only speaks on foreign tours and doesn't consider it necessary to be anwerable to the Parliament.

There can be no bigger threat to this democracy and the Constitution than considering any Government or its Chief beyond any accountability.

This country has witnessed majority governments in the past. The first Lok Sabha had 364 Congress MPs out of total 489 seats, but still the House deliberated for over 600 days on various policies and legislations in its 5 year term. The urgency of new legislations was more crucial than ever, but the executive took the route of consensus building instead of ordinances.

This reflects the constitutional values than Congress party has been built on.

On this note Dr. Ambedkar said-"The task of the Drafting Committee would have been a very difficult one if this Constituent Assembly has been merely a motley crowd. There would have been nothing but chaos. This possibility of chaos was reduced to nil by the existence of the Congress Party inside the Assembly which brought into its proceedings a sense of order and discipline. The Congress Party is, therefore, entitled to all the credit for the smooth sailing of the Draft Constitution in the Assembly." 

Many people may not be aware that at the time of Constitution drafting, the "Cultural Organisation of the Government" was one of the prime critics of Baba Sahib Ambedkar and initially did not recognize the Constitution of India. 

It is said that it was raining outside the Parliament on the day the Constitution was signed, and it was considered a good omen by the people who signed it. 66 years later, in 2015 primarily due to lack of rainfall 2000 farmers have committed suicides till September in Maharashtra alone. This number is highest of the last 5 years. While the Government, which was elected on the promise of "acche din", says that impotency and love affairs are the top reasons behind farmer suicides. 

SHRI PURNO AGITOK SANGMA (TURA): Madam Speaker, as a former Speaker myself, it becomes my duty to help the Chair. Deputy-Speaker has already given a ruling that nobody should speak for more than five minutes. This is a very important debate. I cannot do justice in five minutes. So, I choose not to speak. My time may kindly be given to the hon. Member from Sikkim Shri P.D. Rai. 

HON. SPEAKER: You can. 

SHRI PURNO AGITOK SANGMA: Where is the time?

HON. SPEAKER: I have called your name. You can speak for at least five minutes. You have that right. 

SHRI PURNO AGITOK SANGMA: Madam Speaker, I thank you and I will try to be as short as possible. First of all, I thank the Government and the hon. Speaker for having convened this Special Session to commemorate the 125th Birth Anniversary of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. During my time, there was also an occasion of a Special Session, eight days of Special Session to celebrate the Golden Jubilee. The House was not adjourned even for one minute. It went on for day and night. There was serious discussion. I had expected this time also to be a serious one and to have a serious discussion, two days are not enough. However, what has been decided is decided.

I do not want to deal with all the aspects of the Constitution of India. The Vajpayee Government had appointed a National Commission to review the working of the Constitution. It was a eleven Member Commission. Justice Venkatachaliah was the Chairperson. I also happened to be a Member of that. We had given a series of suggestions to strengthen the Constitution of India. I wish that that Commission’s Report would have been placed on the Table of the House. It could have been circulated. I suggested in all party meeting that this Report could be the basis for discussion in this Special Session. Anyway, there has been a little bit of reservation from some groups. It could not be done. 

I will only deal with that chapter which deals with the Parliament of India. I am a great believer of parliamentary system. Under the Constitution of India, Parliament is the finest institution. If somebody asks me what is the greatest achievement of India after Independence. My answer is uninterrupted parliamentary democracy. There are many countries that got Independence before us, along with us and after us. They could not sustain parliamentary democracy. There have been interruptions -- sometimes Army rule; sometimes President’s rule; and sometime parliamentary form. But India is the only country which has uninterrupted parliamentary system. According to me, the parliamentary system of Government is the only form of Government suitable for a country like ours. 

Looking at the functioning of the Parliament, there has been a debate which is going on in the country. A lot of seminars, a lot of workshops are being held -- I am being invited to attend those – to explore the possibility of an alternative form of Government. The Parliament has failed. It is further failing. Should we not go in for the Presidential form of Government? That is the debate which is going on in the country today. I am strongly opposed to the Presidential form of Government. I am all out for the parliamentary form of Government. We have to continue with the parliamentary system. I have made a lot of points. But I am looking at the clock. 

16.00 hours

But there are things which need to be changed. I think all of us will have to behave better. I have been in Parliament for 32 years now since 1977. I have seen 11 Prime Ministers, 11 Speakers, thousands of Members of Parliament. I have heard so many veterans speak. Beautiful! Beautiful! If you recall the speeches of Vajpayee, L.K. Advani, Somnath Chatterjee, Jyotirmoy Basu, Indrajeet Gupta, George Fernandes, Prof. N.G. Ranga, C.M. Stephen, I have never ever missed attending the Parliament and listening to those tremendous speeches of those veterans. 

Today we do not have a chance to speak. We cannot even judge a Member of Parliament how capable he is, how eloquent he is, the subject he is interested in, because no debate is taking place. We must debate. It is only through debate and discussion that Parliament can be strengthened, not by adjournments, not by shouting of slogans. 

During my time when I became a Member first in 1977, Y.B. Chavan was the leader of the opposition. He said, let us walk out. And the next day the newspapers said, walkout in Parliament was unprecedented. Even walk out was so unprecedented that it made headlines. There was no question of adjournment. I think I was the first Member of Parliament who got the Question Hour adjourned. I am sorry for what I have done. At one point of time I stood on the bench and I spoke and the rule had to be changed. There were occasions like that. But by and large the kind of debate that took place was wonderful.

I have a few suggestions to make. I have seen, you all have seen, that instability and hung Parliaments started in 1989. In subsequent six elections, no party got majority. All were coalitions and there has been complete instability. When I was Speaker, I was Speaker for 18 months only, I had five confidence and no confidence motions in just one year and six months. That has to be rectified. 

My suggestion is, as the Speaker is elected by the House, Prime Minister of India must be elected by Lok Sabha. For fifteen years we have seen a Prime Minister who was a Member of Rajya Sabha and who was not elected to the Lok Sabha. For fifteen years continuously, no Lok Sabha Member was fit to become Prime Minister of this country. Then where is the Parliamentary system. If we have to borrow a Chief Minister, if we have to borrow a Rajya Sabha Member to become the Prime Minister of India, then where is the need for Lok Sabha? The Prime Minister of India must belong to Lok Sabha. … (Interruptions) We must amend the Constitution of India. … (Interruptions) This is my view. 

HON. SPEAKER: Please Gogoi-ji, you are too young to speak like this. It is okay. It is his view. You are too young. 

SHRI PURNO AGITOK SANGMA : You have just come to Parliament. I advise my young parliamentarians to have patience to listen. It is from listening that you learn. Do not try to interrupt like this especially when elders are on their feet. You are too young, too new. 

Prime Minister of India, I still insist, must belong to Lok Sabha and he must be elected by the House, and then President can appoint him. Once Prime Minister is elected, there should be no scope for a confidence motion. There is no provision in the Constitution of India that every Prime Minister should take the confidence of the House. The moment he becomes the Prime Minister, unless he is challenged by non-confidence motion, it should be presumed that he has the confidence of the House. 

Coming to the federal structure, our federalism is a very loose federation. It had to be, because at the time of framing the Constitution, it was a difficult job to introduce a federal system, as somebody has pointed out. In America, it is a federal system where the states came together voluntarily and they formed United States. For us, it was bringing together the states. Sardar Patel had to bring together five hundred and more princely states. So, we are a Union of States whereas America is United States. 

We also have to become United States one day, for which I have a lot of suggestions. But one thing also I do not like. Rajya Sabha is the House of the Elders. It is the Council of the States. Today, anybody can become a Rajya Sabha Member from any State, not belonging to that State. It is incorrect. I have strong reservation about that. For representation in the Upper House, any representative must belong to his State because he is representing the States; it is the House of the States. How can a man from Kerala become a Rajya Sabha MP from Asom? It does not look nice. … (Interruptions) Rajya Sabha is becoming a rehabilitation centre. 

Somebody talked about federalism on language. I am also worried about languages. Many languages are becoming extinct. We have 29 States but we have only 22 languages in the official list. At least each State should have one or two official languages. In northeastern States, except Asom and Manipur, no State has given that recognition. In my State, we have two languages, Garo and Khasi. I demand that both the languages should be included in the Eighth Schedule. Thank you.

SHRI BANDARU DATTATREYA (SECUNDERABAD): I am proud to be heading the Ministry of Labour which was once a portfolio that was held and ably steered by the architect of Indian Constitution, Bharat Ratna Dr. B.R. Ambedkar whose 125th birth anniversary is being celebrated by the country this year. The department of labour was established in November 1937 and Dr. B.R. Ambedkar held the labour portfolio from July 1942 to 1946 in the Viceroy Lord Wavell's Executive Council. 

I sincerely thank the hon. Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modiji for giving me the opportunity to work under his guidance as Labour Minister on this occasion. 

I am proud to place on record that our Ministry is carrying forth the seeds of labour welfare sown by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. Dr. Ambedkar while working as Labour Minister had initiated and framed several laws for employment security, wage security and social security for the work force in India. Some of the major initiatives were; Mines Maternity Benefit Act; Women Labour Welfare Fund, Women and Child Labour Protection Act, Indian Factory Act, National Employment Agency, Mica Mines Labour Welfare Fund, Employees State Insurance and Tripartite Labour Council, etc.

Now I come to details of Labour Welfare measures. The Employee's State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) which is one of the premier health and insurance corporation for the organized labour and which is providing medical health and disability benefits of the workers had been enacted way back in 1942 by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar. Our Ministry under the able guidance of Hon'ble Prime Minister has launched second generation (2.0) reforms on 20th July 2015 for extending the coverage of medical, sickness, maternity, disability and dependent benefits to a larger work force who were earlier either not covered or partially covered. Though these reforms, not only coverage has been expanded but better super specially treatment has been put in place through a string of reforms and establishing of new hospitals and dispensaries. Recently, we have issued orders to cover all the States, including the left out North East States i.e. Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur and Andaman Nicobar Island, districts and construction site workers. Implementation of the health scheme for the unorganized workers (40 crores) is also being planned. 

Concept of employees' provident fund was initiated on the foundation of the law that was framed by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, i.e. mica mines labour fund. The Employees Provident Fund has now grown into an enormously valuable and reliable trustee of 4.5 crore organized workers (subscribers): the Employee Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) under our ministry is a trustee organisation for taking care of welfare needs of the workers after they retire as well as to meet any exigencies during their life time. Our ministry, keeping in tune with changing times, has introduced several technology driven reforms including Universal Account Numbers, which is portable throughout India. 

Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar had framed several laws for the welfare of the women workers in India such as mines maternity benefit act, women labour welfare fund, women and child labour protection act, etc. Our ministry is carrying this legacy and realizing the dreams of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar by adding new provisions which are in sync with changing requirements by fine tuning these laws like extending the facility of maternity to adopting mothers and commissioning mothers also, apart from providing medical care and other health benefits through Employee State Insurance Corporation (ESIC).

Dr. B.R. Ambedkar was instrumental in establishing National Employment Agency which later grew into employment exchanges that are spread across India. Our Ministry is committed to increase the employment opportunities to the vast unemployed youth through a string of more than 890 employment exchanges spread across country which are being remodeled by information technology. The national career council centers which is an IT platform, which has been started, brings together the job seekers under one single umbrella. This platform will also serve as counselling and guiding institution keeping the changing needs of youth. 100 model career centers are also being developed across the length and breadth of India. 

The skill needs of the work force was recognized by Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar who sent engineers abroad for training and formulated a policy for training. Our Government under the inspired leadership of Hon'ble Prime Minister who gave clarion call for "Skill India" and "Make in India" and "digital India" had started a new ministry of skill development and entrepreneurship. Through formation of new ministry the dreams of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar are further strengthened and the training needs of vast work force, who will otherwise become a liability and wither away are also realized. 

Our Ministry is determined to safeguard the job security, wage security and social security. To achieve these objectives several steps have been initated to make changes in existing labour laws as per requirement of today's India. We have started the process of amalgamation, simplification and rationalization of 44 central labour laws into 4 codes, i.e. code on wages, code on industrial relations, code on safety and working conditions and code on social security and welfare. In all these reforms that have been initiated, workers and employers have not only been committed but given equal opportunity to participate actively through tripartite mechanism which was recognized by Dr. B.R. Ambedkar, who had set up a tripartite labour council in 1942 itself. 

I place on record that Dr. B. R. Ambedkar believed in labour movement and introduced Bill for compulsory recognition of trade unions in 1943. Our Ministry not only believes in involving the trade unions in all walks of labour issues and especially in the formulation of labour policies and addressing their demand, the 10 point charter of demands of the central trade unions which were lying unattended to, have been sincerely attempted in right earnest and agreed to most of the demands by holding several levels of discussions and talks with them under the able guidance of Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modiji. 

While bringing forth the less known face of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as a Labour Minister in Viceroy's Executive Council and his contributions to the welfare of the work force, I assure that the Ministry of Labour and Employment and myself are committed to carry forward the legacy of the architect of Indian Constitution under the inspired leadership of Hon'ble Prime Minister. 

*श्री आलोक संजर (भोपाल) ः आज मैं भारत सरकार व देश के प्रधानमंत्री आदरणीय श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी की हृदय से सराहना करना चाहता हॅं। सरकार ने 26 नवंबर को लोकतंत्र के मंदिर में संविधान निर्माता और कृतित्व व व्यव्तित्व पर चर्चा को प्रारंभ किया। कितना सुखद है कि गरीबों, शो­िात-पीड़ितों के मसीहा- बाबासाहेब डाँ. भीमराव अंबेडकर जी की 125वीं जयंती एक रा­ट्रीय त्यौहार की भांति देश में धूमधाम से बनेगी। जहां चाह होती है वहां राह होती है। भारत सरकार ने इस उव्ति को चरितार्थ कर दिखाया है। आज सिर्फ इस चर्चा में बाबासाहेब का ही स्मरण नहीं हो रहा है, उनके साथ-साथ सरदार बल्लभ भाई पटेल, डॉ. श्यामा प्रसाद मुखर्जी, पंडित जवाहर लाल नेहरू, डॉ. राजेन्द्र प्रसाद, मौलाना अब्दुल कलाम आज़ाद जैसे महापुरू­ा मानस पटल पर छाए हुए हैं।

हम सब याद करें, जब भारत माता गुलामी की जंजीरों से मुव्त मुव्त हुई थी तब देश में सदाचरण का माहौल बना था और यह सदाचरण का माहौल ही सहारा बना था संविधान की नव रचना का। संविधान निर्मात्री सभा में एक अलग तरह का रा­ट्र प्रेम का जोश था, तभी उन्होंने विशे­ा ध्यान रखा था कि भारत का भवि­य सुंदर से अति सुंदर हो। देश व उसके नागरिक सदैव संविधान के प्रति अपनी पूर्ण आस्था व प्रतिबद्धता जताते रहे।

हम सबने अपने शैशव काल में अपने बड़ों से, महात्माओं के श्रीमुख से सुना है कि ईश्वर की जिनके ऊपर कृपा होती है वह 84 लाख योनियों के होते हुए भी पुरू­ा योनि में जन्म लेते हैं। इसके बाद जब प्रभु की विशे­ा कृपा होती है तब वह ज्ञान व अज्ञान दुनिया के होते हुए भी पूर्ण संस्कारित देश- जिसे मां का दर्जा दिया हुआ है भारत माता की गोद में जन्म लेते हैं। भारत माता- जिसके कारण देश की संस्कृति व संस्कारों के कारण हमारी पहचान अनेकता से नहीं बल्कि अनेकता में एकता से है। हमारा भारत देश एक बहुत ही बड़ा प्रजातांत्रिक देश है जिसकी विशालता हम सबको राजनैतिक उथल-पुथल से मालूम होती है। भारत माता अनेकों महापुरू­ााो व विभूतियों की जननी है, उन सभी महापुरू­ा व विभूतियों के विचार राजनीति के आकाश में ही नहीं बल्कि सामाजिक, आर्थिक धरातल पर सूर्य की भांति आलौकित हो रहे हैं, भवि­य में भी होते ही रहेंगे। यही कारण है कि हमारे संस्कारों व संस्कति को विश्व सम्मान की दृ­िट से देख रहा है।

वर्तमान का समय देश व हमारे युवाओं के लिए बहुत ही महत्वपूर्ण है। आज युवा तब के शासन में और अब के शासन में अंतर समझने लगा है। देश के युवा ने व­ाऩ 2014 में देखा था जब प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी पहली बार संसद में आए थे और उन्होंने लोकतंत्र के मंदिर की प्रथम सीढ़ी पर अपना पहला कदम नहीं रखा बल्कि उन्होंने प्रथम सीढ़ी पर अपना मस्तक रख दिया था। उन्होंने सिर्फ लोकतंत्र के मंदिर ही नहीं, संविधान के पूज्य ग्रंथ के प्रति अपनी पूर्ण आस्था से अवगत कराया था। उन्होंने देश के सभी महापुरू­ााो, शहीदों, रा­ट्र भव्तों एवं संविधान निर्मात्री सभा के प्रति अटूट नि­ठा व समर्पण को प्रदर्शित किया था था, आत्मिक नमन व स्मरण किया था। उसी दिन देश ही नहीं समूचा विश्व इस रा­ट्रभव्ति व महापुरू­ााो के प्रति सम्मान व देश और उसके नागरिकों की रक्षा के भाव को देखकर आश्वस्त हो गया था कि देश की बागडोर अब सही हाथों में देश के लोकतंत्र ने थमा दी है।

व­ाऩ 2014 के पहले का कुछ समय छोड़ दें जो आदरणीय अटल बिहारी वाजपेयी जी के प्रधानमंत्री के शासन काल का था, तो हम देखेंगे कि देश की दशा क्या थी? हम कह सकते हैं कि दशा अर्थात् ""द"" से दयनीय और ""शा"" से शासन। देश ने दयनीय शासन कभी नहीं चाहा लेकिन सहना पड़ा। हमारे राजनैतिक पूर्वज हमेशा यही इच्छा रखते थे, ण्यही प्रेरणा देते रहे हैं कि देश हमेशा एक सही दिशा में जाए। नेतृत्व ऐसा मिले जो स्वयं के स्वार्थ को छोड़कर, रा­ट्र व उसके नागरिकों को अपना र्स्वस्य माने, किंतु पिछले दशकों में देश वह सब नहीं देख सका, जिसे वह देखना चाहता था और व­ाऩ 2014 में देश की जनता ने अपनी ताकत से दिखाया कि देश में लोकतंत्र अमर है। देश ने सर्वमानय नेता श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में सुनहरे भवि­य की ओर अग्रसर होने का आदेश दिया। देश एक सही दिशा में संविधान के प्रति आस्था व विश्वास के साथ "चैरेवेति-चैरेवेति" मंत्र के साथ सार्थक कदमों से गतिशील हो चला।

इसलिए आज हम कह सकते हैं कि देश "दिशा" पर है। दिशा अर्थात् "दि" से दिव्य और "शा" से शासन- हम सब, हमारा देश, सारा विश्व भारत में दिव्य शासन के दर्शन कर रहा है। विदेशों में भारत की साख बढ़ रही है। वह देश भी नतमस्तक हो रहे हैं, जो हमारे देश और देशवासियों के जीवन से खिलवाड़ करते रहे हैं।

देश के यशस्वी प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी देश की नव पीढ़ी को अहसास करवा रहे हैं कि युवाओं की शिराओं में जो रव्त बह रहा है, यह रव्त हमारा रव्त नहीं है, यह हमारे पूर्वजों का रव्त- जिन्होंने रा­ट्र की रक्षा के लिए अपने प्राण गंवाये थे। वह रा­ट्रभव्ति आज भी हमारे खून में है। इसलिए रा­ट्र के स्वाभिमान के लिए हम सभी जो भी काम कर रहे हैं, संपूर्ण ईमानदारी से करें ताकि भारत का भवि­य भी वही गौरव प्राप्त कर सके, जिसे इस देश के महापुरू­ााो ने प्राप्त किया था।

आज इस लोकतंत्र के मंदिर में हम सब संविधान निर्मात्री सभा के सभी महानुभावों का स्मरण करते हुए- क्षेत्रवाद, जातिवाद, वंशवाद से ओत-प्रोत गंदी राजनीति, भ्र­टाचार जिसके कारण पिछले छह दशकों में सदाचरण का माहौल बिगड़ा व देश की संस्कृति पर भी दु­प्रभाव पड़ा, उसे बचाने के लिए, माहौल सुधारने के लिए व हमारी संस्कृति को नवीन पहचान दिलाने के लिए सर्वस्व लगाना पड़ेगा, आगे आना पड़ेगा।

इस आवश्यकता को महसूस किया और समझा है और बाबासाहेब डॉ. भीमराव अंबेडकर जी जैसे महापुरू­ा की 125वीं जयंती मनाने का निर्णय लिया गया है। निश्चित ही, देश वर्तमान माननीय श्री मोदी जी व उनकी सरकार के नेतृत्व में स्वर्णिम युग के सतमार्ग पर बढ़ रहा है। आज़ादी के बाद का यह सातावां दशक नव सूर्य के साथ एकात्म मानव दर्शन को लेकर वर्तमान का समय चक्र गतिशील है। बाबासाहेब की 125वीं जयंती को धूधमधाम से मनाना सही अर्थों में संविधान व लोकतंत्र के प्रति अपनी प्रतिबद्धता पर कायम रहना है। सच्ची श्रद्धांजलि भी यही है कि हमें राजनीति नहीं करनी है- धर्म की, जाति की, क्षेत्र की, भ्र­टाचार की। हमें राजनीति करनी है- सिर्फ और सिर्फ रा­ट्र के उत्थान की, सामाजिक संतुलन की, एक-दूसरे को जोड़ने की।

*श्री रविन्दर कुशवाहा (सलेमपुर) ः बाबासाहेब भीमराव अंबेडकर की 125वीं जयंती एवं संविधान दिवस 26 नवंबर के अवसर पर लोकसभा में "भारत के संविधान के प्रति प्रतिबद्धता" वि­ाय पर चर्चा कराये जाने के लिए मैं भारत सरकार, माननीय प्रधानमंत्री, माननीय संसदीय कार्य मंत्री, माननीय गृह मंत्री के प्रति आभार व्यव्त करता हॅं। इस महत्वपूर्ण वि­ाय पर ऐसे समय चर्चा कराए जाने का सराहनीय प्रयास हुआ है जब केंद्र सरकार और भारतीय जनता पार्टी को कमज़ोर करने की साजिश के तहत कांग्रेस और अन्य विपक्षी दल तथा पिछली कांग्रेसी सरकारों द्वारा पो­िात एवं अलंकृत किए गए कुछ तथा कथित बुद्धजीवी और कलाकारों ने असहि­णुता जैसे अप्रसांगिक मुद्दों को उछालने के साथ ही भारतीय संविधान की गलत व्याख्या करने का अभियान चला रखा है। भारत दुनिया का सबसे बड़ा लोकतांत्रिक देश है और उसका अपना एक संविधान है जिसे बनाने में किसी एक व्यव्ति का नहीं बल्कि स्वतंत्रता संग्राम के अग्रणी नेताओं तथा विद्वान जनप्रतिनिधियों का सहयोग है। बाबासाहेब भीमराव अंबेडकर एक शिल्पी थे जिन्होंने इस महान नेताओं और विद्वानों के महत्वपूर्ण सुझावों को पिरोकर भारतीय संविधान को मूर्त रूप दिया। देश के विभिन्न समुदायों के अपने धार्मिक ग्रंथ है परंतु एक भारतीय के रूप में, "भारत का संविधान" ही हमारा सबसे बड़ा धर्मग्रंथ है जिससे अनावश्यक छेड़छाड़ नहीं होनी चाहिए। मैं आपकी इस राय से सहमत हॅं कि समय और समाज की आवश्यकता को देखते हुए संविधान में संशोधन तो किया जा सकता है परंतु इसकी प्रस्तावना से छेड़छाड़ नहीं होनी चाहिए, क्योंकि वही हमारे संविधान का प्राण है। लेकिन आज़ादी के बाद कांग्रेस की केंद्रीय सरकारों ने संविधान संशोधन की व्यवस्था का दुरूपयोग किया और अपने निहित स्वार्थ एवं सत्ता को बचाने के लिए उसमें जरूरत से अधिक और अनावश्यक संशोधन किए। मैं कांग्रेस पार्टी के मित्रों को याद दिलाना चाहता हूं कि उनकी नेता स्वर्गीय श्रीमती इंदिरा गांधी ने अपनी सरकार बनाने और बचाने के लिए 1971 में केवल 4 व­ाऩ बाद तथा 1977 में 6 व­ाऩ बाद लोकसभा का आम चुनाव कराने के लिए संशोधनों के नाम पर भारतीय संविधान को कलंकित किया था।

*डॉ. प्रीतम गोपीनाथ मुंडे (बीड) ः मैं सबसे पहले 26 नवंबर, संविधान दिवस तथा भारतीय संविधान के शिल्पकार डॉ. बाबासाहेब अंबेडकर अपने देश के प्रथम प्रधानमंत्री जवाहर लाल नेहरू इन दोनों की 125वीं जयंती व­ाऩ की शुभकामनाएंì देती हूं।

आज अपने देश की सरकार जो कि आदरणीय मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में बनी है, बेहद प्रशंसा के काबिल है, क्योंकि यह पहली बार है कि संविधान दिवस मनाने के बारे में किसी सरकार ने सोचा। महापुरू­ााो की जयंती और पुण्यतिथि हम सब मनाते हैं किंतु संविधान ने हमें ये आज़ादी, ये अधिकार दिये कि हम अपने नायक चुने, उनके प्रति अपनी भावनाएंì व्यव्त कर सके, उस संविधान का सम्मान किया जाये, ऐसा इससे पूर्व किसी ने नहीं सोचा।

बहुत से वव्ताओं ने संविधान में प्रस्तुत अनेक मुद्दों पर विस्तृत मार्गदर्शन किया। मैं सिर्फ यह पूछना चाहती हॅं कि क्या संविधान को समझाना मतलब समाज के सारे तबकों से केवल अपने हक की मांग करना है? क्या हमारे कर्त्तव्यों के बारे में हमें सोचना नहीं चाहिए? इस संदर्भ में मैं यह कहना चाहूंगी कि मेरे साथी सांसद श्री राम मोहन नायडू जी ने कहा कि वोटिंग कंपल्सरी किया जाना चाहिए ताकि समाज के आखिरी आदमी तक मतदान का अधिकार पहुंचे, वह अपना कर्त्तव्य निभा सके और फिर उसे उसका फल मिल सके।

जहां तक संविधान में पिछड़े वर्गों को मुख्य धारा में लाने के बारे में लिखा गया है, उसमें अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति के संदर्भ में बातें काफी हद तक स्प­ट है। उन्हें संवैधानिक अधिकार हैं किंतु अन्य पिछड़ी जाति/वर्ग के लिए ऐसा कोई प्रावधान नहीं है। ओ.बी.सी. हमारे देश की जनसंख्या का काफी बड़ा हिस्सा है और उनका विकास उन तक पहुंचे इसलिए ओ.बी.सी. कमीशन को कॉस्टीटय़ूशनल दर्जा मिलना चाहिए ताकि यह सोशियो इकोनोमिकली बैकवर्ड लोग मुख्य प्रवाह में आये। जब मैं यह कहती हॅं कि ओ.बी.सी. एक बड़ा हिस्सा है तो मैं एक निश्चित आंकड़ा नहीं बता सकती, क्योंकि आज तक जातिनिहाय जनगणना नहीं हो पाई है। जब हम रिजर्वेशन की बात करते हैं तो किसको कितना हिस्सा मिले यह तय करने के मापदंड क्या है? जब किसी जाति की जनसंख्या हमें मालूम नहीं तो हम उनके रिजर्वेशन का प्रतिशत किस आधार पर करते हैं। जातिनिहाय जनगणना और ओ.बी.सीज को कांस्टीटय़ूशनल राईट्स दिए जाने के बारे में सरकार जल्द कुछ निर्णय करे, ऐसी मैं दरख्वास्त करती हॅं।

एक महिला सांसद होने के नाते मैं महिला सशव्तिकरण के बारे में कुछ कहूं यह अपेक्षित है। महिलाओं की सुरक्षा के बारे में कदम उठाने चाहिए। उनको सामाजिक निर्माण और उत्थान की मुख्य धारा में लाना चाहिए। इन मुद्दों से मैं सहमत हॅं, पर आज मैं संसद में जब अपनी आजू-बाजू इतनी सारी महिला सांसदों को देखती हूं, आज जब एक ओ.बी.सी. महिला होते हुए मैं अपने देश की सर्वोच्च संस्था संसद में बात करने के लिए खड़ी हूं, यह प्रंाळवीलेज मुझे अपने संविधान से मिला है और इसी वजह से एक भारतीय नागरिक होने के नाते मुझे अपने संविधान पर फक्र महसूस होता है।

Yes we have a long way to go in achieving all the goals of our constitution written by hon'ble Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar, we also have to appreciate the fact that we have reached this point. Yes, we have to keep our eyes on the future path but at the same time let us not ignore the evolutionary past journey that led us to this bright present.

अंत में, मैं भारतीय संविधान के निर्माण और गठन में अपने योगदान देने वाले सभी महानायकों और उसके पश्चात् इस संविधान की मर्यादा में अपने देश को चलाने में अपनी जिम्मेदारी निभाने वाली अब तक की सारी भारतीय सरकारों को नमन करती हॅं।

SHRI B.S. YEDIYURAPPA(SHIMOGA): Dr. Bheemrao Ambedkar is not a mere human being, he is not just an institution by himself, he is also not just institution-builder, I would like to consider Dr. Ambedkar as an "ideology" by himself in the form of a human being (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar siruf "Vyakti" nahi hai; He is a "Vichaar" by himself).

Many members have spoken in this august House earlier, so I would not like to be repetitive, Let me remind my Congress friend that it is the BJP government when I was the Chief Minister, the allocation for the SC/STs and BCs was increased by 110 percent, every hostel belonging to the SC/STs and BCs were repaired, which had not happened for several decades. 

Once again, it was under the BJP regime in Karnataka when I was the Chief Minister, women belonging to Dalits and Backward Classes living in the rural areas were provided monetary incentive. 

I am unable to understand the logic advanced by the Opposition Congress on the issue of Constitutional Principles after having debased the Constitution many times for selfish political ends. Who amended the Constitution to suspend the people's fundamental rights? The Congress. Who missed Article 356 to dismiss state governments as many as 36 times. The Congress. Who imposed Press Censorship? Under whose regime excess was perpetrated on innocent people and Opposition leaders? The Congress. Who sought to alter the basic structure of the Constitution? The Congress. Who wanted a judiciary committed to the then ruling party? The Congress. 

After having misused the Constitution for selfish political ends, now the Congress is accusing the BJP of not adhering to the Constitutional Principles. This is a cruel joke being played by the Congress. 

It is the Congress which is anti-Ambedkar and has scant respect for the Constitution. 

Let me elaborate. I have gone through the proceedings of the Constituent Assembly. Dr. Ambedkar never wanted Article 370 that gave special status to Jammu and Kashmir. Even Sardar Patel did not want Article 370. But it was Pandit Nehru who insisted that Kashmir must be given Special Status under Article 370.

With great reluctance and with a lot of pain and agony, Dr. Ambedkar agreed to make provision for Article 370 but with a rider Dr. Ambedkar insisted that this Article 370 would be "a temporary phenomenon" and "erode away" gradually. But today, the Congress Party shouts against anybody who demands abrogation of Article 370. We in the BJP wants Article 370 to go. We are echoing Dr. Ambedkar's opinion but the Congress wants Article 370 to stay which is against Dr. Ambedkar's stance;

Article 48 of the Directive Principles of the State Policy states that "there should be a complete ban on cow slaughter"; Dr. Ambedkar wanted this to be a part of the concurrent list. That means that Dr. Ambedkar wanted a total ban on Cow slaughter but the Congress has been opposing the law to ban cow slaughter; Is this not anti-Ambedkar? Now the Congress has the check to accuse the BJP of flouting Constitutional Principles. Shame on the Congress.

In 1986, the Supreme Court ruled that a Muslim woman -Shah Bano - is entitled for alimony; but the Congress government over-ruled the Apex Court judgment by amending the Constitution with the help of brute majority in the Parliament; 

Is this not intolerance? What do you call this? Respect to Constitution or dis-respect to Constitution? Shame on the Congress party. Dr. Ambedkar did not want "mercy" to be shown to dalit brethren; instead he wanted Equality of All under the law; The BJP is following the principles of Ambedkar in true letter and spirit by adopting the motto "Justice and Equality for All; Appeasement and Discrimination of None".

Our Hon'ble Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi ji's mantra is "Skill Development of All" which is its character. Today millions of Dalit brethren, minority brethren are undergoing skill training. And the Congress party has the check to accuse us of flouting Constitutional Principles.

Dr. Bheemrao Ambedkar is no less than Lord Buddha and Lord Basaveshwara. They are all Yoga Purushas; Let us not make them a private property of one party or one community. They belong to entire mankind throughout the universe. 

In the end, I would like to state that the Congress is a party of hypocrites; it has paid lip-sympathy and cosmetic-respect to Ambedkar. In fact, the Congress has gone against Dr. Ambedkar's principles; its criticism of BJP is without substance. If the Constitution is safe, then it is only in the hands of the BJP.

*श्री मोहम्मद असरारूल हक (किशनगंज) ः हिंदुस्तान की असल ताकत उसकी जम्हूरियत और उसका आईन है। यहां के तकसीरी मुआशरे को इत्तेहाद व यकजहती की डोर इसी जम्हूरी आईन ने बांध रखा है। जिसका निस्बुलएन बिला इम्तेआज़ रंगो-नस्ल जिन्स व मज़हब और ज़ुबानो व सकाफत, मुल्क के हर शहरी के लिए इंसाफ, आज़ादी और मसावात है। दुनिया के सबसे तवीर, तरीन, तहरीरी आईन था। जो 26 जनवरी, 1950 में हिंदुस्तान और हर हिंदुस्तानी के लिए कानून बन गया। हमारे इस आइन को अपने वजूद के रोज़े अव्वल से आज तक मुल्क की कुछ ताकतों की तरफ से इस आईन की रूह, जिसे जम्हूरियत, सैक्युलरिज्म, आज़ादी व खुदमुख्तारी और सालिमियत को भयानक खतरात का सामना करना पड़ रहा है। उन ताकतों से जो यह चाहती हैं कि हिंदुस्तान सैक्युलर मुल्क न रहे, और जम्हूरियत के रास्ते पर न चले। हालांकि हमारे मुल्क सालमियत और यकजहती के लिए जम्हूरियत, सैक्युलरिज्म और रवादारी से ज्यादा अहम कोई सिस्टम नहीं है और यह हमारी जिम्मेदारी है कि हम देखें कि यह सिस्टम बीमार न होने पाए। सैक्युलरिज्म और रवादारी हमारे मुल्क के खमीर में शामिल है। अगर हम उसको अपने मुल्क के जिस्म से निकाल देंगे, तो उसकी रूह फ़ना हो जाएगी।

वज़ीरे दाख़ला राजनाथ जी ने हाऊस में आईन पर बहस का आगाज़ करते हुए, आईन के ताल्लुक से जिस सोच का इज़हार किया है, वह हिंदुस्तान की सोच से हमआहंग नहीं हैं, बल्कि उनकी सोच पर उन कुव्वतों की सोच का गहरा साया नज़र आता है, जो कुव्वतें, न सैक्युलरिज्म को मानती हैं और न ही जम्हूरियत को अहमयित देती हैं। उन कुव्वतों ने न मुल्क की आज़ादी की जंग में हिस्सा लिया, और न ही कभी आईने हिंद पर इत्मिनान का इज़हार किया है। वज़ीरे दाखला की तकरीर से यह बात खुल कर सामने आ गई, बल्कि यूं कहिए की बिल्ली थैले से बाहर आ गई कि मोदी सरकार के मन में क्या है। ये लोग मुल्क की बात कम करते हैं और मन की बात ज्यादा करते हैं। उन्होंने सैक्युलरिज्म और सोशलिज्म पर एतराज़ करते हुए, सैक्युलरिज्म की जैसी तशरी की है, उससे वाज़या हो गया कि ये लोग आईन में कैसी तरमीम करना चाहते हैं। बिहार की अवाम ने बरवव्त उनके मन की बात को समझ लिया। इसलिए वहां असंबेली इलैक्शन में उन्हें जबरदस्त शिकश्त का सामना करना पड़ा और अब अंदाज़ा हो रहा है कि आइंदा असेंबली इंतेखाबात में उनको हर जगह आवामी हिमायत की महरूमी का शिकार होना पड़ेगा।

मोहतरम वज़ीरे दाखला ने फरमाया कि आईन के ताल्लुक से हम पाबंद अहद है और अपनी आइनी जिम्मेदारियों को बखूबी निभा रहे हैं। लेकिन क्या भाजपा के लीडरान, पार्लियामेंट के मेंबरान, वज़रा और यहां तक कि मुख्तलिफ रियासतों में आईनी ओहदों पर फायिज़, उनके मुक्कर्रकरदा गवर्नर साहिबान के जो मुसलसल गैर-जिम्मेदारानां बयानात आ रहे हैं और जिन पर मुल्क के वज़ीरे आज़म मुसलसल चुप्पी साधे हुए हैं। उन बयानातों से आइनी जिम्मेदारियां पूरी हो रही हैं या आइने हिंद की धज्जियां उड़ायी जा रही हैं। अपनी तकरीर में उनको बताना चाहिए था कि दादरी में महज़ अफ़वाह की बुनियाद पर मोहम्मद अखलाक को पीट-पीट कर जुनूनियों की एक भीड़ ने मार डाला और उसके नौजवान बेटे को अधमरा कर दिया। इसी तरह बल्लभगढ़ में दो मासूम दलित बच्चों को जला कर मार डाला गया और उनके वज़ीर ने उस पर बयान देते हुए बच्चों को कुत्ता कह दिया और उन दोनों मामलों में आईनी ज़मानत के बावजूद आईन की जिस तरह खिल्ली उड़ायी गई, इनकी हुकूमत ने उस सिलसिले में अपनी आइनी जिम्मेदारियों को अदा करने के लिए क्या कार्यवाही की है?

""इतनी न बढ़ा पाकाई दामन की हिमायत,

दामन को ज़रा देख, ज़रा हिंद कया देख।""

उनकी जंगे आज़ादी में मुल्क के तमाम तबकों ने कांधे से कांधा मिलाकर लाफानी कुर्बानियां दी हैं। मुसलमानों ने भी बढ़-चढ़ कर हिस्सा लिया और उलमा ने उसमें कायदाना किरदार अदा किया। हम यहां पैदा हुए हैं और इसी मिट्टी में मिल जाएंगे और अपने प्यारे वतन की मिट्टी की खुशबू को अपने से कभी दूर नहीं करेंगे। हम यहां की कौमियत, यहां की सकाफत और यहां की तमद्दुन में इस तरह पैवस्त हैं कि हमको जुदा नहीं किया जा सकता है। यहां हमारी मौजूदगी पर शिकवा, हमारा और दवा दवा गंगा से ज्यादा हकीकी और पायदार है। हमारी उम्र ताज़महल और कुतुबमीनार से ज्यादा लंबी है और इस मुल्क पर हमारा हक काबिले फख्र यादगारों से ज्यादा मुस्तहकम है, जिनको हमारी सलाहियतों ने वजूद बक्शा है। हम हुकूमत से मुतालबा करते हैं कि अक्लियतों, बिलखुसूस मुसलमानों के साथ होने वाली नाइंसाफियों को और मज़ालिम को रोका जाए। हमें मराआत नहीं चाहिए, बल्कि हमें दस्तूरी और आइनी हुकूक दिए जाएं।

""मिला क्या है, हमें बारूद की फ़सलें उगाकर,

कोई बस्ती मोहब्बत की बसा देते तो अच्छा था।""
